-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem mvcc.crevUB_agree (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (q1 q2 : Qp) (c1 c2 : Int) (h1 : -1 ≤ c1) (h2 : -1 ≤
    c2) : ⊢ mvcc.crevUB γ q1 c1 -∗ mvcc.crevUB γ q2 c2 -∗ ⌜c1 = c2⌝

theorem mvcc.certOk_persistent (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (log : mvcc.Log) : Persistent (mvcc.certOk γ
    log)

def mvcc.errorfIs (err : GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ x,
      ⌜err = interface.mkOk errors.errorString.ty.PointerType (intoVal x)⌝ ∗
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            (▷ ∀ str, Φ (intoVal str)) -∗
              WP
                ((intoVal (methods errors.errorString.ty.PointerType go!"Error" (intoVal x)))
                  (intoVal ()))
                {{ Φ }})

theorem mvcc.idxCert_lastRev (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (log : mvcc.Log) (hne : log ≠ []) : mvcc.idxCert
    γ.idx log ⊢ ⌜0 ≤ sint.Z (W64 (↑(List.length log) - 1))⌝

theorem mvcc.compactTok_mono (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c c' : Int) (h : c ≤ c') : mvcc.compactTok γ c ⊢
    mvcc.compactTok γ c'

def mvcc.alarmBI : backend.BucketInfo :=
  { id := W64 4, name := go!"alarm", safe := false }

def mvcc.writerOwn (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.storeRT γ ∗ mvcc.retiredAt γ (2 + mvcc.nJobRd γ.kb))

def mvcc.mwKey (γmk : GName) : IProp GF :=
  ghostVar γmk (Qp.half 1) true

theorem mvcc.isTxnWrite_small (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) (ld : Bool) :
    mvcc.isTxnWrite mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev Z ld ⊢ ⌜mvcc.logCh ilog +
    pend.length < receiptBound GF ∧ receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 48⌝ ∗ mvcc.isTxnWrite mw s γ trace ilog
    pend puts deletes putSize crev Z ld

theorem mvcc.mwSlot_alloc (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : ghostVar γ.mwk 1 true ⊢ mvcc.mwSlot γ ∗
    mvcc.mwRest γ

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_idx_hist (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys
    p).idx.hist = γ.idx.hist

structure mvcc.StoreNames : Type where
  idx : mvcc.IdxNames
  bucket : GName
  clog : GName
  leases : GName
  revs : GName
  hook : GName
  hookFn : GName
  kb : Option mvcc.KBReal
  cmeta : GName
  fin : GName
  sch : schedule.SchedNames
  cok : GName
  watchQ : Bool
  wr : GName
  wk : GName
  wv : GName
  cur : GName
  rst : GName
  tk : GName
  tko : GName
  wsd : GName
  tkw : GName
  tkr : GName
  mwk : GName
  cm : Bool
  sx : GName
  cperm : GName

theorem mvcc.crevRightM_off (γs : mvcc.StoreNames) (h : γs.cm = false) : mvcc.crevRightM γs ⊣⊢ True

theorem mvcc.wsFrozenM_persistent (γs : mvcc.StoreNames) : Persistent (mvcc.wsFrozenM γs)

theorem mvcc.crevUB_noDel (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (k : GoString) : ⊢ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx q (-1)
    -∗ mvcc.delKey γ k -∗ False

theorem mvcc.curAt_halves (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : mvcc.curAt γ
    (DFrac.own q) o ⊣⊢ mvcc.curAt γ (DFrac.own q.half) o ∗ mvcc.curAt γ (DFrac.own q.half) o

def mvcc.isStopChan (c : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γc, ownBroadcastChan c γc iprop(True) Broadcast.Unknown)

theorem mvcc.delKey_eq_delKeyI (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (k : GoString) : mvcc.delKey γ k = mvcc.delKeyI
    γ.idx k

theorem mvcc.bucketView_join_quarters (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (m1 m2 : mvcc.Bucket) : mvcc.bucketView
    γ (Qp.half 1).half m1 ∗ mvcc.bucketView γ (Qp.half 1).half m2 ⊢ ⌜m1 = m2⌝ ∗ mvcc.bucketView γ
    (Qp.half 1) m1

def mvcc.lagTok (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c cp : Int) : IProp GF :=
  if cp = c then iprop(True) else ghostVar γ.wsd (Qp.half 1).half ()

def mvcc.storeRT (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  mvcc.kbRT γ.kb

theorem mvcc.bkReq_persistent (γB : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (X Y : IProp GF)
    : Persistent (mvcc.bkReq γB P b X Y)

theorem mvcc.kbBt_persistent (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) (bt : GoInterfaceOk) : Persistent (mvcc.kbBt
    kb bt)

theorem mvcc.readerPool_checkout_ws (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (dq : DFrac) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : ⊢ £ 1
    -∗ mvcc.readerPool γ -∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq o -∗ ownToks γ.tk 1 -∗ mvcc.wsDep γ ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.idxSlot
    γ o ∗ ownToks γ.tkw 1 ∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq o

def mvcc.crevPermIs (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (Perm : Int → IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  savedPredOwn γ.cperm DFrac.discard fun c => iprop(□ Perm c)

theorem mvcc.storeBackend_persistent (b : GoInterface) (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp
    GF) : Persistent (mvcc.storeBackend b s γ P)

def mvcc.writerFrag (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ o, mvcc.curAt γ (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1).half.half) o)

def mvcc.revLockW (s : Loc) (q : Qp) (RevP RevK : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ Ψ,
      RevP -∗
        (▷
            ∀ v,
              typedPointsto
                  (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
                    go!"currentRev" s)
                  v (DFrac.own q) -∗
                RevK -∗ Ψ (intoVal ())) -∗
          WP
            ((intoVal
                (methods sync.RWMutex.ty.PointerType go!"Lock"
                  (intoVal
                    (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"revMu" s))))
              (intoVal ()))
            {{ Ψ }})

theorem mvcc.revMuInv_open (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (dq : DFrac) : mvcc.revMuInv s γ
    q ∗ dghostVar γ.rst dq false ⊢ (∃ γp, mvcc.revMuBodyL s γ γp q ∗ mvcc.revMuTok γ γp q) ∗
    dghostVar γ.rst dq false

theorem mvcc.writerOwn_rt (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : mvcc.writerOwn γ ⊢ mvcc.storeRT γ ∗ (mvcc.storeRT
    γ -∗ mvcc.writerOwn γ)

theorem mvcc.revMuInv_open_held (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (c : Int) (ti : Loc) :
    mvcc.revMuInv s γ q ∗ mvcc.muHeld s γ c ti ⊢ mvcc.revMuBody s γ γ q ∗ mvcc.revMuTok γ γ q ∗
    mvcc.muHeld s γ c ti

def mvcc.hookInit (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) (f : val) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.hookP γ P ∗
      match γ.kb with
      | none => mvcc.hookFn γ f
      | some val => True)

inductive mvcc.TxnKind : Type
  | mvcc.TxnKind.read (log : mvcc.Log) (rev : w64) : mvcc.TxnKind
  | mvcc.TxnKind.write (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) :
      mvcc.TxnKind

def mvcc.storeDlReg (γB : backend.BNames) (γi : mvcc.IdxNames) : IProp GF :=
  backend.dlReg γB fun nk => iprop(⌜nk.fst = go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.keyName⌝ ∗ mvcc.delKeyI γi nk.snd)

def mvcc.storeFields (s : Loc) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) (dq : DFrac) : IProp GF :=
  iprop("Hfb" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"b" s) o.b dq ∗
      "Hfidx" ∷
          typedPointsto
            (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"kvindex"
              s)
            (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.treeIndex.ty.PointerType (intoVal o.ti)) dq ∗
        "Hfsch" ∷
            typedPointsto
              (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
                go!"fifoSched" s)
              o.ssched dq ∗
          "Hfstop" ∷
            typedPointsto
              (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"stopc" s) o.sstop
              dq)

def mvcc.fieldShareAt (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : IProp GF :=
  iprop("Hcur" ∷ mvcc.curAt γ (DFrac.own q.half) o ∗
      "Hflds" ∷ mvcc.storeFields s o (DFrac.own q) ∗
        "Hfrst" ∷ dghostVar γ.rst (DFrac.own q.half) false ∗ "#Hph" ∷ □ mvcc.physOk s γ o)

def mvcc.kbNoDelOff (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : IProp GF :=
  if mvcc.kbCmpM kb then iprop(True) else mvcc.kbNoDel kb

theorem mvcc.compactJobResM_of (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate (mvcc.nJobRd
    kb) (), mvcc.kbRT kb) ∗ mvcc.kbSRM kb ⊢ mvcc.compactJobResM kb

theorem mvcc.snapThin_frozen (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (m m' : mvcc.Bucket) : ⊢ mvcc.crevFrozen γ -∗
    mvcc.snapThin m m' (mvcc.delKey γ) ={⊤}=∗ ⌜m' = m⌝

theorem mvcc.crevPermAt_elim_lc (E : CoPset) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (Perm : Int → IProp GF) (c : Int)
    : £ 1 ∗ mvcc.crevPermIs γ Perm ∗ mvcc.crevPermAt γ c ⊢ |={E}=> ⌜c = -1⌝ ∨ □ Perm c

def mvcc.certOkNext (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜pend = []⌝ ∨ mvcc.certOk γ (ilog ++ [pend]))

theorem mvcc.KBReal.P_withCm (d : mvcc.KBReal) (c : Bool) : { γB := d.γB, BT := d.BT, hookMax :=
    d.hookMax, limit := d.limit, be := d.be, gx := d.gx, cm := c }.P = d.P

theorem mvcc.muInv_fractional (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : Fractional (mvcc.muInv s γ)

theorem mvcc.storeTxnWriteIs_split {trace : Loc} (tw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog :
    mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF := iprop(True)) (ld : Bool :=
    false) : mvcc.storeTxnWriteIs tw s γ trace ilog pend crev Z ld ⊢ ∃ chs ps,
    mvcc.storeTxnWriteCore tw s γ trace ilog pend chs ps false crev Z ld ∗ ownSlice chs ps
    (DFrac.own 1) ∗ mvcc.changesAre ps ilog pend

theorem mvcc.fieldShare_of_at (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) :
    mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ q o ⊢ mvcc.fieldShare s γ q

def mvcc.rdCap2 (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (Tok : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ s1 s2 b1 b2,
        Rd s1 b1 -∗
          Rd s2 b2 -∗
            Tok -∗ ∃ dq1 dq2, ownSlice s1 b1 dq1 ∗ ownSlice s2 b2 dq2 ∗ (ownSlice s1 b1 dq1 -∗ ownSlice s2 b2 dq2 -∗ Tok))

theorem mvcc.writerOwn_off (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (h : mvcc.nJobRd γ.kb = 0) : mvcc.writerOwn γ ⊣⊢
    mvcc.storeRT γ ∗ mvcc.retiredAt γ 2

theorem mvcc.idxSealed_withPhys (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) (L : mvcc.Log) :
    mvcc.idxSealed (γ.withPhys p).idx L = mvcc.idxSealed γ.idx L

theorem mvcc.restoreLogOk_nil : mvcc.restoreLogOk []

def mvcc.logQPre (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) : IProp GF :=
  if pend = [] ∨ γ.watchQ = false then iprop(True) else mvcc.logQ γ ilog

theorem mvcc.restoreLogOk_len {R : mvcc.Log} (h : mvcc.restoreLogOk R) : 2 ≤ ([[], []] ++ R).length
    ∧ ([[], []] ++ R).length ≤ mvcc.logCh ([[], []] ++ R) + 2

def mvcc.writerRes (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ L,
      "Hwk" ∷ mvcc.writerKey γ ∗
        "Hwv" ∷ ghostVar γ.wv (Qp.half 1) L ∗
          "Hbv" ∷ mvcc.bucketViewL γ (Qp.half 1).half L ∗
            "#Hcert" ∷ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx L ∗ "%Hne" ∷ ⌜L ≠ []⌝ ∗ "Hcres" ∷ mvcc.compactRes γ)

theorem mvcc.bucketViewL_exact (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (L : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.bucketView γ q
    (mvcc.bucketMap L) ⊢ mvcc.bucketViewL γ q L

theorem mvcc.hookOk_persistent (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) (f : val) : Persistent
    (mvcc.hookOk γ P f)

def mvcc.metaCompact (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (sched fin : Option w64) : IProp GF :=
  ghostVar γ.cmeta q (sched, fin)

def mvcc.storeBackend (b : GoInterface) (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ Dep,
      mvcc.isKeyBackendG b (mvcc.bucketView γ) (mvcc.storeRT γ) (mvcc.storeWT γ) (mvcc.kbNoCmp γ.kb γ.bucket)
        (mvcc.storePutOk γ) (mvcc.delKey γ) (mvcc.storeW s γ) (mvcc.kbWi γ.kb) Dep (mvcc.storeCmp γ) P (mvcc.hookFn γ)
        (mvcc.storeReq γ) (mvcc.storeRb γ) (mvcc.storeBt γ) (mvcc.kbSR γ.kb) (mvcc.kbSRh γ.kb) (mvcc.kbMW γ.kb γ.bucket)
        (mvcc.kbHookNil γ.kb))

def mvcc.crevFrozen (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  inv mvcc.crevFrozenN (mvcc.crevUB γ.idx (Qp.half 1) (-1))

theorem mvcc.bucketViewL_halves (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (L : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.bucketViewL γ q
    L ⊣⊢ mvcc.bucketViewL γ q.half L ∗ mvcc.bucketViewL γ q.half L

theorem mvcc.storeW_get (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : mvcc.storeRegd s γ ∗ mvcc.storeW s γ ⊢
    mvcc.writerRes s γ

def mvcc.certFree (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  W64 0 ↪[γ.cok]□ []

theorem mvcc.revQ_add (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q1 q2 : Qp) : mvcc.revQ γ (q1 + q2) = mvcc.revQ γ q1 +
    mvcc.revQ γ q2

theorem mvcc.certOk_withPhys (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) (L : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.certOk
    (γ.withPhys p) L = mvcc.certOk γ L

theorem mvcc.writerInv_checkout (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (dq : DFrac) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) :
    ⊢ £ 1 -∗ mvcc.writerInv s γ -∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq o -∗ mvcc.storeW s γ -∗ mvcc.wDep γ ={⊤}=∗
    mvcc.writerL s γ ∗ mvcc.storeRegd s γ ∗ (∃ L, ghostVar γ.wv (Qp.half 1) L ∗ mvcc.bucketViewL γ
    (Qp.half 1).half L ∗ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx L ∗ ⌜L ≠ []⌝ ∗ mvcc.compactRes γ) ∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq o

def mvcc.txnEndPost (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : mvcc.TxnKind → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => iprop(True)
  | mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts deletes putSize =>
    iprop(mvcc.idxCert γ.idx (mvcc.commitLog ilog pend) ∗
        (if pend = [] then mvcc.revToken γ else True) ∗
          mvcc.logQPost γ ilog pend ∗ mvcc.writerFrag γ ∗ mvcc.writerPin γ (mvcc.commitLog ilog pend))

theorem mvcc.isKeyBackendG_persistent (b : GoInterface) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT WT
    NC : IProp GF) (PutOk : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop) (Del : GoString →
    IProp GF) (W Wi Dep : IProp GF) (Cmp : Prop) (P : IProp GF) (HF : val → IProp GF) (Req : IProp
    GF → IProp GF → IProp GF) (Rb : GMap GoString backend.BktData → IProp GF) (Bt : GoInterfaceOk →
    IProp GF) (SR SRh MW HN : IProp GF) : Persistent (mvcc.isKeyBackendG b View RT WT NC PutOk Del W
    Wi Dep Cmp P HF Req Rb Bt SR SRh MW HN)

def mvcc.revLag (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (c cp : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜-1 ≤ cp ∧ cp ≤ c⌝ ∗ if cp = c then True else ghostVar γ.wsd q.half.half ())

theorem mvcc.putMax_ge (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : 2 ^ 56 ≤ mvcc.putMax γ

theorem mvcc.revMuInv_open_share (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) (q q' : Qp) (o
    : mvcc.StoreObjs) : mvcc.revMuInv s γ q ∗ mvcc.fieldShareAt s (γ.withPhys p) q' o ∗ ghostVar
    γ.wsd 1 () ⊢ mvcc.revMuBody s γ (γ.withPhys p) q ∗ mvcc.revMuTok γ (γ.withPhys p) q ∗
    mvcc.fieldShareAt s (γ.withPhys p) q' o ∗ ghostVar γ.wsd 1 ()

def mvcc.logQ (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (log : mvcc.Log) : IProp GF :=
  mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.idx (Qp.half 1).half log

def mvcc.wsDep (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  ghostVar γ.wsd 1 ()

theorem mvcc.writerReg_get (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (E : CoPset) (h : ↑mvcc.regN ⊆ E) : ⊢
    mvcc.storeW s γ ∗ mvcc.writerReg s γ ={E}=∗ mvcc.writerRes s γ ∗ mvcc.storeRegd s γ

theorem mvcc.rangeOutcomeC_latest (r : Loc) (err : GoInterface) (log : mvcc.Log) (rev : w64) (crev :
    Int) (endNil : Bool) (k e : GoString) (ro : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.RangeOptions)
    (hro : sint.Z ro.Rev' ≤ 0) (hc : crev ≤ sint.Z rev) : mvcc.rangeOutcomeC r err log rev crev
    endNil k e ro ⊢ mvcc.rangeOutcome r err log rev endNil k e ro

theorem mvcc.mwSwap_persistent (W MW : IProp GF) : Persistent (mvcc.mwSwap W MW)

theorem mvcc.kbWTSupply_persistent (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : Persistent (mvcc.kbWTSupply kb)

def mvcc.stopPayAt (γx : GName) (γs : schedule.SchedNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(dghostVar γx DFrac.discard o.sstop ∗ schedule.schedPayIs γs (mvcc.stopPay γx))

def mvcc.storeReaderC (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop("Hmu" ∷ sync.ownRWMutex (mvcc.muAddr s) (mvcc.muInv s γ) ∗
      "HrevMu" ∷ sync.ownRWMutex (mvcc.revMuAddr s) (mvcc.revMuInv s γ) ∗ "Htk" ∷ ownToks γ.tk 1)

def mvcc.pairVals (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (ks vs : GoSlice) (l : List (GoString ×
    GoString)) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ kss vss,
      ownSlice ks kss DFrac.discard ∗
        ownSlice vs vss DFrac.discard ∗
          ⌜kss.length = l.length ∧ vss.length = l.length⌝ ∗
            [∗list] i ↦ p ∈ l,
              iprop(∃ ksl vsl, ⌜kss[i]? = some ksl ∧ vss[i]? = some vsl⌝ ∗ □ Rd ksl p.fst ∗ □ Rd vsl p.snd))

theorem mvcc.noCompactor_persistent (γs : mvcc.StoreNames) : Persistent (mvcc.noCompactor γs)

theorem mvcc.isStopChan_persistent (c : Loc) : Persistent (mvcc.isStopChan c)

theorem mvcc.ownTokAuth_halves (γr : GName) (n : Nat) : ownTokAuth γr n ⊣⊢ ownTokAuthDfrac γr
    (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) n ∗ ownTokAuthDfrac γr (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) n

def mvcc.kbWT (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : IProp GF :=
  match kb with
  | none => iprop(True)
  | some d => backend.wbTok d.γB

def mvcc.retiredAt (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (r : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  ghostVar γ.tkr (Qp.half 1) r

def mvcc.revUnlockW (s : Loc) (q : Qp) (L' : mvcc.Log) (RevK V RevQ : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ Ψ,
      typedPointsto
          (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
            go!"currentRev" s)
          (W64 (↑(List.length L') - 1)) (DFrac.own q) -∗
        RevK -∗
          V -∗
            ▷ (RevQ -∗ Ψ (intoVal ())) -∗
              WP
                ((intoVal
                    (methods sync.RWMutex.ty.PointerType go!"Unlock"
                      (intoVal
                        (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"revMu"
                          s))))
                  (intoVal ()))
                {{ Ψ }})

theorem mvcc.fieldShareAt_idx (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) :
    mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ q o ⊢ typedPointsto (structFieldRef
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"kvindex" s) (interface.mkOk
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.treeIndex.ty.PointerType (intoVal o.ti)) (DFrac.own q) ∗
    (typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"kvindex" s)
    (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.treeIndex.ty.PointerType (intoVal o.ti))
    (DFrac.own q) -∗ mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ q o)

theorem mvcc.kbRegRight_timeless (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : Timeless (mvcc.kbRegRight kb)

def mvcc.restBuckets : List GoString :=

theorem mvcc.crevPermAt_true (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : (mvcc.crevPermIs γ fun x =>
    iprop(True)) ⊢ mvcc.crevPermAt γ c

def mvcc.writerKey (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  ghostVar γ.wk 1 ()

theorem mvcc.muHeld_idx (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) (ti : Loc) : mvcc.muHeld s γ c ti
    ⊢ typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"kvindex" s)
    (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.treeIndex.ty.PointerType (intoVal ti))
    (DFrac.own sync.rfrac.half) ∗ (typedPointsto (structFieldRef
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"kvindex" s) (interface.mkOk
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.treeIndex.ty.PointerType (intoVal ti)) (DFrac.own
    sync.rfrac.half) -∗ mvcc.muHeld s γ c ti)

def mvcc.batchTxSpecG (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT WT : IProp GF)
    (PutOk : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop) (Del : GoString → IProp GF) (W
    Dep : IProp GF) (Cmp : Prop) (Locked : mvcc.Puts → IProp GF) (P : IProp GF) (HF : val → IProp
    GF) (Rb : GMap GoString backend.BktData → IProp GF := fun x => iprop(True)) (MW : IProp GF) (HN
    : IProp GF := iprop(False)) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((□
        ∀ Pre Q f,
          □
            ∀ Φ,
              (Pre ∗ RT ∗ WT ∗ HF f ∗ □ □ ∀ Φ, P ∗ Pre -∗ ▷ (Q -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP (f (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) -∗
                ▷ (Locked [] ∗ W ∗ Q ∗ RT -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                  WP
                    ((intoVal
                        (methods bt.ty
                          go!"LockInsideApply"
                          bt.v))
                      (intoVal ()))
                    {{ Φ }}) ∗
      (□
          ∀ l q m b key val k v,
            □
              ∀ Φ,
                typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Key) b DFrac.discard ∗
                    Locked l ∗ View q m ∗ ownSlice key k DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice val v DFrac.discard ∗ ⌜PutOk m l k v⌝ -∗
                  ▷ (Locked (l ++ [(k, v)]) ∗ View q m -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                    WP
                      ((((intoVal
                              (methods bt.ty
                                go!"UnsafeSeqPut" bt.v))
                            (intoVal b))
                          (intoVal key))
                        (intoVal val))
                      {{ Φ }}) ∗
        (□
            □
              ∀ Φ,
                Locked [] ∗ W ∗ P -∗
                  ▷ (True -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                    WP ((intoVal (methods bt.ty go!"Unlock" bt.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) ∗
          (□
              ∀ l m Q,
                □
                  ∀ Φ,
                    Locked l ∗ View 1 m ∗ (View 1 (List.foldl (fun m p => <[p.fst := p.snd]>m) m l) -∗ W ∗ Q) ∗ P -∗
                      ▷ (Q -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                        WP ((intoVal (methods bt.ty go!"Unlock" bt.v)) (intoVal ()))
                          {{ Φ }}) ∗
            (□
                ∀ l q m b key k dq,
                  □
                    ∀ Φ,
                      typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Key) b DFrac.discard ∗
                          Locked l ∗ View q m ∗ ownSlice key k dq -∗
                        (▷
                            ∀ ks vs,
                              (∃ Rd T,
                                  T ∗
                                    (T -∗ Locked l) ∗
                                      mvcc.rdCap Rd T ∗
                                        View q m ∗
                                          ownSlice key k dq ∗
                                            (mvcc.keyVals Rd ks vs (List.foldl (fun m p => <[p.fst := p.snd]>m) m l) k ∨
                                              Del k ∗ ownSlice ks [] DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice vs [] DFrac.discard)) -∗
                                Φ (intoVal ks, intoVal vs)) -∗
                          WP
                            (((((intoVal
                                      (methods bt.ty
                                        go!"UnsafeRange" bt.v))
                                    (intoVal b))
                                  (intoVal key))
                                (intoVal slice.nil))
                              (intoVal (W64 0)))
                            {{ Φ }}) ∗
              (□
                  □
                    ∀ Φ,
                      Dep ∗ RT ∗ WT -∗
                        ▷ (Locked [] ∗ W ∗ P ∗ RT -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                          WP
                            ((intoVal
                                (methods bt.ty
                                  go!"LockOutsideApply"
                                  bt.v))
                              (intoVal ()))
                            {{ Φ }}) ∗
                □
                    (⌜Cmp⌝ -∗
                      ∀ q m b lo hi klo khi limit dqlo dqhi,
                        ⌜0 < sint.Z limit ∧ sint.Z limit ≤ mvcc.rangeLimitMax ∧ khi ≠ []⌝ →
                          □
                            ∀ Φ,
                              typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Key) b DFrac.discard ∗
                                  Locked [] ∗ View q m ∗ ownSlice lo klo dqlo ∗ ownSlice hi khi dqhi -∗
                                (▷
                                    ∀ ks vs,
                                      (View q m ∗
                                          ownSlice lo klo dqlo ∗
                                            ownSlice hi khi dqhi ∗
                                              ∃ m' Rd U,
                                                U ((sint.Z limit).toNat + 1) ∗
                                                  mvcc.snapThin m m' Del ∗
                                                    (□ ∀ n, mvcc.rdCap Rd (U n)) ∗
                                                      (□ ∀ n, mvcc.rdCap2 Rd (U n)) ∗
                                                        mvcc.pairVals Rd ks vs
                                                            (List.take (sint.Z limit).toNat
                                                              (mvcc.bucketRange m' klo khi)) ∗
                                                          (□
                                                              ∀ key k n,
                                                                □
                                                                  ∀ Φ,
                                                                    typedPointsto
                                                                          (globalAddr
                                                                            go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Key)
                                                                          b DFrac.discard ∗
                                                                        U (n + 1) ∗ Del k ∗ □ Rd key k -∗
                                                                      ▷ (U n -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                                                                        WP
                                                                          (((intoVal
                                                                                (methods bt.ty
                                                                                  go!"UnsafeDelete"
                                                                                  bt.v))
                                                                              (intoVal b))
                                                                            (intoVal key))
                                                                          {{ Φ }}) ∗
                                                            (□
                                                                ∀ n,
                                                                  mvcc.metaPutCap bt iprop(U (n + 1) ∗ MW)
                                                                    iprop(U n ∗ MW)) ∗
                                                              □
                                                                ∀ n,
                                                                  □
                                                                    ∀ Φ,
                                                                      U n ∗ W ∗ P -∗
                                                                        ▷ (True -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                                                                          WP
                                                                            ((intoVal
                                                                                (methods bt.ty
                                                                                  go!"Unlock"
                                                                                  bt.v))
                                                                              (intoVal ()))
                                                                            {{ Φ }}) -∗
                                        Φ (intoVal ks, intoVal vs)) -∗
                                  WP
                                    (((((intoVal
                                              (methods bt.ty
                                                go!"UnsafeRange"
                                                bt.v))
                                            (intoVal b))
                                          (intoVal lo))
                                        (intoVal hi))
                                      (intoVal limit))
                                    {{ Φ }}) ∗
                  □
                      (⌜Cmp⌝ -∗
                        mvcc.metaPutCap bt iprop(Locked [] ∗ MW) iprop((∃ U, U ∗ mvcc.unlockAt bt View W P U []) ∗ MW)) ∗
                    (□
                        ∀ l b key k dq r,
                          □
                            ∀ Φ,
                              typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Lease) b DFrac.discard ∗
                                  Locked l ∗ ownSlice key k dq ∗ Rb r -∗
                                ▷
                                    ((∃ U, U ∗ mvcc.unlockAt bt View W P U l) ∗
                                        ownSlice key k dq ∗ Rb (mvcc.rbDel r mvcc.leaseName k) -∗
                                      Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                                  WP
                                    (((intoVal
                                          (methods bt.ty
                                            go!"UnsafeDelete"
                                            bt.v))
                                        (intoVal b))
                                      (intoVal key))
                                    {{ Φ }}) ∗
                      mvcc.lockNilSpec bt RT WT W P HN Locked)

def (sealed) mvcc.viewFk (γb : GName) (f : Nat) : IProp GF

theorem mvcc.isLessor_persistent (le : GoInterface) (γl : GName) : Persistent (mvcc.isLessor le γl)

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_sx (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys p).sx =
    p.sx

def mvcc.putMax (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : Nat :=
  mvcc.kbPutMax γ.kb

def mvcc.batchTxSpec (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (Del : GoString →
    IProp GF) (W Dep : IProp GF) (Locked : mvcc.Puts → IProp GF) (P : IProp GF) (HF : val → IProp
    GF) (MW : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  mvcc.batchTxSpecG bt View iprop(True) iprop(True) mvcc.noPutCond Del W Dep True Locked P HF (fun x => iprop(True)) MW

def mvcc.kbRT (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : IProp GF :=
  match kb with
  | none => iprop(True)
  | some d => iprop(backend.rdTok d.γB d.P d.be ∗ backend.bOpen d.γB backend.rdOpen)

theorem mvcc.mwSwap_of_inv (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (R : IProp GF) : mvcc.mwInv γ ⊢ mvcc.mwSwap
    iprop(mvcc.mwKey γ.mwk ∗ R) (mvcc.kbMW γ.kb γ.bucket)

def mvcc.bucketViewC (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (m : mvcc.Bucket) : IProp GF :=
  mvcc.kbViewC γ.kb γ.bucket q m

theorem mvcc.crevUB_raise (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (c c2 : Int) (h : c ≤ c2) : ⊢ mvcc.crevUB γ (Qp.half
    1) c -∗ mvcc.crevUB γ (Qp.half 1).half c -∗ mvcc.crevUB γ (Qp.half 1).half c ==∗ mvcc.crevUB γ
    (Qp.half 1) c2 ∗ mvcc.crevUB γ (Qp.half 1).half c2 ∗ mvcc.crevUB γ (Qp.half 1).half c2 ∗
    mvcc.crevLb γ c2

def mvcc.compactTok (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((∃ c', ⌜c' ≤ c⌝ ∗ mvcc.idxCompactor γ.idx c') ∗ mvcc.compactJobResM γ.kb)

def mvcc.leaseParams (P : backend.BParams) : Prop :=
  P.has mvcc.leaseBI ∧ P.RB mvcc.leaseName = true ∧ ∀ (k : GoString), P.hk mvcc.leaseName k = false

theorem mvcc.mwSlot_on (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (h : mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb) : mvcc.mwSlot γ ⊣⊢ mvcc.mwKey
    γ.mwk

theorem mvcc.isTxnWrite_split {trace : Loc} (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF :=
    iprop(True)) (ld : Bool := false) : mvcc.isTxnWrite mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize
    crev Z ld ⊢ ∃ chs ps, mvcc.isTxnWriteCore mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize chs ps
    false crev Z ld ∗ ownSlice chs ps (DFrac.own 1) ∗ mvcc.changesAre ps ilog pend

theorem mvcc.curAt_agree_o (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (dq dq' : DFrac) (o o' : mvcc.StoreObjs) :
    mvcc.curAt γ dq o ∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq' o' ⊢ ⌜o = o'⌝

theorem mvcc.writerRes_timeless (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : Timeless (mvcc.writerRes s γ)

def mvcc.restoreView (b : GoInterface) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (RT : IProp GF) (q : Qp) (R : mvcc.Log)
    : IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.restoreViewOut γ q R ∗
      if R = [] then True else mvcc.keyCleanRead b (mvcc.bucketViewC γ) RT (mvcc.kbNoCmp γ.kb γ.bucket))

theorem mvcc.bucketLog_off (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L : mvcc.Log) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (h : ¬mvcc.kbCmpM
    γ.kb) : mvcc.bucketLog γ L m ⊢ ⌜m = mvcc.bucketMap L⌝

    mvcc.Bucket) (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (Tok : IProp GF) (Del : GoString → IProp GF) :
    mvcc.keyReadLocked RT NC rng rt m' Rd Tok ∗ mvcc.snapThin m m' Del ⊢ mvcc.keyReaderD rt m Tok
    Del

    γ γp)

def mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : mvcc.StoreNames :=
  { idx := { hist := γ.idx.hist, nev := p.nev, log := γ.idx.log, crev := γ.idx.crev, cmp := p.cmp }, bucket := p.bucket,
    clog := γ.clog, leases := γ.leases, revs := γ.revs, hook := p.hook, hookFn := p.hookFn, kb := p.kb, cmeta := p.cmeta,
    fin := p.fin, sch := p.sch, cok := γ.cok, watchQ := γ.watchQ, wr := γ.wr, wk := p.wk, wv := p.wv, cur := γ.cur,
    rst := γ.rst, tk := γ.tk, tko := γ.tko, wsd := γ.wsd, tkw := γ.tkw, tkr := γ.tkr, mwk := p.mwk, cm := γ.cm,
    sx := p.sx, cperm := γ.cperm }

    : IProp GF) (PutOk : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop) (Del : GoString →
    IProp GF) (W Wi Dep : IProp GF) (Cmp : Prop) (P : IProp GF) (HF : val → IProp GF) (Rb : GMap
    GoString backend.BktData → IProp GF) (Bt : GoInterfaceOk → IProp GF) (MW HN : IProp GF) :
    Persistent (mvcc.isBatchTxG bt View RT WT PutOk Del W Wi Dep Cmp P HF Rb Bt MW HN)

theorem mvcc.compactQueue_mono (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c c' : Int) (h : c ≤ c') : mvcc.compactQueue γ
    c ⊢ mvcc.compactQueue γ c'

def mvcc.kbSR (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : IProp GF :=
  match kb with
  | none => iprop(True)
  | some d => backend.srSlot d.be

def mvcc.stopPay (γx : GName) : IProp GF :=
  match hlc, hG, sem with
  | HasLC.hasLC, hG', x =>
    iprop(∃ c, dghostVar γx DFrac.discard c ∗ ∃ γc, ownBroadcastChan c γc iprop(True) Broadcast.Done)
  | HasLC.hasNoLC, x, x_1 => iprop(True)

theorem mvcc.txnEndPre_write (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) (f : val) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend
    : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) : mvcc.hookIs γ P f ∗ P ∗ mvcc.certOkNext γ
    ilog pend ∗ mvcc.logQPre γ ilog pend ⊢ mvcc.txnEndPre γ (mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts
    deletes putSize)

theorem mvcc.revMuRest_fractional (s : Loc) : Fractional (mvcc.revMuRest s)

theorem mvcc.writerReg_alloc (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (E : CoPset) : ⊢ mvcc.storeRegd s γ
    ={E}=∗ mvcc.writerReg s γ

theorem mvcc.bucketLog_exact (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L : mvcc.Log) : ⊢ mvcc.bucketLog γ L
    (mvcc.bucketMap L)

def mvcc.certOk (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (log : mvcc.Log) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜List.length log ≤ 2⌝ ∨ W64 ↑(List.length log) ↪[γ.cok]□ log ∨ W64 0 ↪[γ.cok]□ [])

theorem mvcc.revMuInv_withPhys (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : mvcc.revMuInv
    s (γ.withPhys p) = mvcc.revMuInv s γ

syntax mvcc.tacticWithPhys_simp

def mvcc.kbWi (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : IProp GF :=
  match kb with
  | none => iprop(True)
  | some d => mvcc.lateW d.gx

theorem mvcc.txnEndPre_write_plain (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) (f : val) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (h : γ.watchQ = false) : mvcc.hookIs γ P
    f ∗ P ∗ mvcc.certOkNext γ ilog pend ⊢ mvcc.txnEndPre γ (mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts
    deletes putSize)

def mvcc.kbCmpM_dec (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : Decidable (mvcc.kbCmpM kb) :=
  id
    (Option.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
      kb = t →
        Decidable
          (match kb with
          | none => True
          | some d => d.cm = true))
      kb (fun h => ⋯ ▸ inferInstance) (fun val h => ⋯ ▸ inferInstance) ⋯)

def mvcc.keyReaderD (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (R : IProp GF) (Del : GoString → IProp
    GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ b key k dq,
      □
        ∀ Φ,
          typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Key) b DFrac.discard ∗
              R ∗ ownSlice key k dq -∗
            (▷
                ∀ ks vs,
                  (∃ Rd T,
                      T ∗
                        (T -∗ R) ∗
                          mvcc.rdCap Rd T ∗
                            ownSlice key k dq ∗
                              (mvcc.keyVals Rd ks vs m k ∨
                                Del k ∗ ownSlice ks [] DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice vs [] DFrac.discard)) -∗
                    Φ (intoVal ks, intoVal vs)) -∗
              WP
                (((((intoVal
                          (methods rt.ty go!"UnsafeRange" rt.v))
                        (intoVal b))
                      (intoVal key))
                    (intoVal slice.nil))
                  (intoVal (W64 0)))
                {{ Φ }})

theorem mvcc.kbNoCmp_MW (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) (γb : GName) : mvcc.kbNoCmp kb γb ⊢ mvcc.kbMW kb
    γb

def mvcc.writerInv (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  inv mvcc.writerN (mvcc.writerInvBody s γ)

theorem mvcc.wsDep_withPhys (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : mvcc.wsDep (γ.withPhys p) =
    mvcc.wsDep γ

def mvcc.rangeVals (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (ks vs : GoSlice) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (klo khi
    : GoString) : IProp GF :=
  mvcc.pairVals Rd ks vs (mvcc.bucketRange m klo khi)

def mvcc.lockedIs (ld : Bool) (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (W P : IProp
    GF) (Locked : mvcc.Puts → IProp GF) (l : mvcc.Puts) : IProp GF :=
  match ld with
  | false => Locked l
  | true => iprop(∃ U, U ∗ mvcc.unlockAt bt View W P U l)

theorem mvcc.muHeld_tree (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) (ti : Loc) : mvcc.muHeld s γ c ti
    ⊢ mvcc.muHeld s γ c ti ∗ mvcc.isTreeIndex ti γ.idx

theorem mvcc.hookOk_agree (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P P' : IProp GF) (f f' : val) : mvcc.hookOk γ P f ∗
    mvcc.hookOk γ P' f' ⊢ ⌜f = f'⌝ ∗ ▷ P ≡ P'

theorem mvcc.isTxnRead_trace_acc (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (log : mvcc.Log)
    (rev : w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF := iprop(True)) : mvcc.isTxnRead mw s γ trace log rev
    crev Z ⊢ (∃ te, traceutil.ownTrace trace te) ∗ ((∃ te, traceutil.ownTrace trace te) -∗
    mvcc.isTxnRead mw s γ trace log rev crev Z)

theorem mvcc.metaReadTx_persistent (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (RT : IProp GF) : Persistent
    (mvcc.metaReadTx rt RT)

theorem mvcc.fieldShareAt_cur (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) :
    mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ q o ⊢ mvcc.curAt γ (DFrac.own q.half) o ∗ (mvcc.curAt γ (DFrac.own q.half)
    o -∗ mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ q o)

theorem mvcc.crevFrozen_alloc (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (E : CoPset) : ⊢ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx (Qp.half 1)
    (-1) ={E}=∗ mvcc.crevFrozen γ

theorem mvcc.curAt_fractional (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : Fractional fun q =>
    mvcc.curAt γ (DFrac.own q) o

def mvcc.isTxnEnd (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (kind : mvcc.TxnKind) (crev :
    Int) (Z : IProp GF := iprop(True)) : IProp GF :=
  match kind with
  | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => mvcc.isTxnRead mw s γ trace log rev crev Z
  | mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts deletes putSize =>
    iprop(∃ chs ps sealed ld, mvcc.isTxnWriteCore mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize chs ps sealed crev Z ld)

theorem mvcc.mwSwap_frameU (K W MW : IProp GF) : □ (W ={⊤}=∗ K ∗ (K ={⊤}=∗ W)) ∗ mvcc.mwSwap K MW ⊢
    mvcc.mwSwap W MW

theorem mvcc.nReaders_val : mvcc.nReaders = 805306367

theorem mvcc.rangeOutcomeC_live (r : Loc) (err : GoInterface) (log : mvcc.Log) (rev : w64) (crev :
    Int) (endNil : Bool) (k e : GoString) (ro : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.RangeOptions)
    (h : sint.Z ro.Rev' ≤ sint.Z rev → crev ≤ sint.Z (mvcc.rangeRev rev ro.Rev')) :
    mvcc.rangeOutcomeC r err log rev crev endNil k e ro ⊢ mvcc.rangeOutcome r err log rev endNil k e
    ro

theorem mvcc.storeCmp_cmpM (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (h : mvcc.storeCmp γ) : mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb

theorem mvcc.wDep_withPhys (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : mvcc.wDep (γ.withPhys p) =
    mvcc.wDep γ

theorem mvcc.storeTxnReadIs_rev (tr s : Loc) (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (trace : Loc) (γ :
    mvcc.StoreNames) (log : mvcc.Log) (rev : w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) : mvcc.storeTxnReadIs
    tr s rt trace γ log rev crev Z ⊢ ⌜0 ≤ sint.Z rev ∧ sint.Z rev < ↑(List.length log)⌝

    γ.watchQ = false) : mvcc.logQPre γ ilog pend = iprop(True)

    ⊢ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx sync.rfrac.half.half c ∗ (mvcc.crevUB γ.idx sync.rfrac.half.half c -∗
    mvcc.muHeld s γ c ti)

theorem mvcc.isTxnWriteCore_seal {trace : Loc} (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (chs : GoSlice) (ps : List Loc) (hne :
    pend ≠ []) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF := iprop(True)) (ld : Bool := false) : ⊢
    mvcc.isTxnWriteCore mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize chs ps false crev Z ld ==∗
    mvcc.isTxnWriteCore mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize chs ps true crev Z ld ∗
    mvcc.idxSealed γ.idx (ilog ++ [pend])

    GoString → IProp GF) : mvcc.snapThin m m' Del ⊢ mvcc.snapThin (List.foldl (fun m p => <[p.fst :=
    p.snd]>m) m l) (List.foldl (fun m p => <[p.fst := p.snd]>m) m' l) Del

    p.wk

def mvcc.bkView (γB : backend.BNames) (q : Qp) (m : mvcc.Bucket) : IProp GF :=

def mvcc.isTxn (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (kind : mvcc.TxnKind) (crev : Int)
    (Z : IProp GF := iprop(True)) : IProp GF :=
  match kind with
  | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => mvcc.isTxnRead mw s γ trace log rev crev Z
  | mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts deletes putSize =>
    mvcc.isTxnWrite mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev Z

theorem mvcc.logQPost_plain (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (h :
    γ.watchQ = false) : mvcc.logQPost γ ilog pend = iprop(True)

def mvcc.rangeOutcome (r : Loc) (err : GoInterface) (log : mvcc.Log) (rev : w64) (endNil : Bool) (k
    e : GoString) (ro : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.RangeOptions) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜sint.Z rev < sint.Z ro.Rev'⌝ ∗
        (∃ ef,
            typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.ErrFutureRev) (GoInterface.ok ef)
                DFrac.discard ∗
              ⌜err = GoInterface.ok ef⌝) ∗
          typedPointsto r { KVs' := slice.nil, Rev' := rev, Count' := W64 (-1) } (DFrac.own 1) ∨
      ⌜sint.Z ro.Rev' ≤ sint.Z rev⌝ ∗
          ⌜ro.CountOnly' = false ∧ ro.FastKeysOnly' = false⌝ ∗ ⌜r = null⌝ ∗ mvcc.errorfIs err ∨
        ⌜sint.Z ro.Rev' ≤ sint.Z rev⌝ ∗
          ⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
            if ro.CountOnly' = true then
              typedPointsto r
                { KVs' := slice.nil, Rev' := rev,
                  Count' := W64 ↑(mvcc.rangeAnswers log endNil k e (mvcc.rangeRev rev ro.Rev')).length }
                (DFrac.own 1)
            else
              ∃ kvs,
                typedPointsto r
                    { KVs' := kvs, Rev' := rev,
                      Count' :=
                        W64 ↑(mvcc.rangeTotal log endNil k e (mvcc.rangeRev rev ro.Rev') ro.Limit' ro.WithTotalCount') }
                    (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                  mvcc.rangeKvs (!ro.FastKeysOnly') kvs (mvcc.stateAt log (sint.nat (mvcc.rangeRev rev ro.Rev')))
                    (mvcc.rangeTaken log endNil k e (mvcc.rangeRev rev ro.Rev') ro.Limit'))

theorem mvcc.bucketMap_init : mvcc.bucketMap [[], []] = ∅

theorem mvcc.isTxnWrite_frozen (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) : ⊢ mvcc.isTxnWrite mw s γ
    trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev (mvcc.crevFrozen γ) ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.isTxnWrite mw s γ
    trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev (mvcc.crevFrozen γ) ∗ ⌜crev = -1⌝

    Timeless (D k)] : Timeless (mvcc.snapThin m m' D)

    mvcc.StoreObjs) : ⊢ £ 1 -∗ mvcc.readerPool γ -∗ mvcc.curAt (γ.withPhys p) dq o -∗ ownToks γ.tk 1
    -∗ mvcc.wDep γ ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.idxSlot (γ.withPhys p) o ∗ ownToks γ.tko 1 ∗ mvcc.curAt (γ.withPhys
    p) dq o

def mvcc.snapThin (m m' : mvcc.Bucket) (Del : GoString → IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜∀ (k v : GoString), m' !! k = some v → m !! k = some v⌝ ∗ □ ∀ k v, ⌜m !! k = some v ∧ m' !! k = none⌝ -∗ Del k)

def mvcc.keyVals (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (ks vs : GoSlice) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (k :
    GoString) : IProp GF :=
  match m !! k with
  | some v =>
    iprop(∃ ksl vsl, ownSlice ks [ksl] DFrac.discard ∗ □ Rd ksl k ∗ ownSlice vs [vsl] DFrac.discard ∗ □ Rd vsl v)
  | none => iprop(ownSlice ks [] DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice vs [] DFrac.discard)

    (mvcc.bucketViewL γ q L)

def mvcc.bkBt (be : Loc) (bt : GoInterfaceOk) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ t,
      ⌜bt = { ty := go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTxBuffered.ty.PointerType, v := intoVal t }⌝ ∗
        typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"batchTx" be) t DFrac.discard ∗
          □
            □
              ∀ Φ,
                True -∗
                  (▷
                      ∀ t',
                        typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"batchTx" be) t' DFrac.discard -∗
                          Φ
                            (intoVal
                              (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTxBuffered.ty.PointerType
                                (intoVal t')))) -∗
                    WP
                      ((intoVal
                          (methods go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.backend.ty.PointerType
                            go!"BatchTx" (intoVal be)))
                        (intoVal ()))
                      {{ Φ }})

    mvcc.mwInv γ ∗ mvcc.writerReg s γ

theorem mvcc.changesAre_snoc (ps : List Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (c :
    mvcc.Change) (p : Loc) (kv : EtcdKv) (hps : ps.length = pend.length) (hkv : mvcc.changeKv (W64
    ↑(List.length ilog)) (mvcc.stateAfter ilog) (pend ++ [c]) pend.length = some kv) :
    mvcc.changesAre ps ilog pend ∗ mvcc.kvPtrIs true p kv ⊢ mvcc.changesAre (ps ++ [p]) ilog (pend
    ++ [c])

    Persistent (mvcc.bucketLog γ L m)

def mvcc.lockNilSpec (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (RT WT W P HN : IProp GF) (Locked : mvcc.Puts → IProp GF)
    : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ Pre,
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            Pre ∗ RT ∗ WT ∗ HN -∗
              ▷ (Locked [] ∗ W ∗ P ∗ Pre ∗ RT ∗ HN -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                WP
                  ((intoVal
                      (methods bt.ty
                        go!"LockInsideApply"
                        bt.v))
                    (intoVal ()))
                  {{ Φ }})

def mvcc.isStore (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ le lg scfg shs,
      "#Hle" ∷
          typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"le" s) le DFrac.discard ∗
        "#Hlessor" ∷ mvcc.isLessor le γ.leases ∗
          "#Hlg" ∷
              typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"lg" s) lg
                DFrac.discard ∗
            "%Hlgnn" ∷ ⌜lg ≠ null⌝ ∗
              "#Hmu" ∷ sync.isRWMutexGuard (mvcc.muAddr s) (mvcc.muInv s γ) ∗
                "#HrevMu" ∷ sync.isRWMutexGuard (mvcc.revMuAddr s) (mvcc.revMuInv s γ) ∗
                  "#Hcfg" ∷
                      typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"cfg" s)
                        scfg DFrac.discard ∗
                    "%Hcfgl" ∷
                        ⌜0 < sint.Z scfg.CompactionBatchLimit' ∧ sint.Z scfg.CompactionBatchLimit' ≤ mvcc.rangeLimitMax⌝ ∗
                      "#Hhashes" ∷
                          typedPointsto
                            (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
                              go!"hashes" s)
                            (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.hashStorage.ty.PointerType
                              (intoVal shs))
                            DFrac.discard ∗
                        "#HhsOk" ∷ mvcc.hashStorageOk shs ∗
                          "#Hwi" ∷ mvcc.writerInv s γ ∗
                            "#Hpool" ∷ mvcc.readerPool γ ∗
                              "#Hc0" ∷ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx [[], []] ∗ "%Hrb" ∷ ⌜receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 48⌝)

theorem mvcc.bucketView_agree (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q1 q2 : Qp) (m1 m2 : mvcc.Bucket) :
    mvcc.bucketView γ q1 m1 ∗ mvcc.bucketView γ q2 m2 ⊢ ⌜m1 = m2⌝

  go!"finishedCompactRev"

def mvcc.crevRightM (γs : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  if γs.cm = true then mvcc.crevUB γs.idx (Qp.half 1) (-1) else iprop(True)

theorem mvcc.mwSwap_writerRes (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (h : mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb) : mvcc.mwInv γ
    ⊢ mvcc.mwSwap (mvcc.writerRes s γ) (mvcc.kbMW γ.kb γ.bucket)

def mvcc.keyReadSnapC (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT NC : IProp GF) (rt : GoInterfaceOk)
    (m : mvcc.Bucket) (L : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ q,
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            L ∗ View q m -∗
              ▷ ((View q m ∗ ∃ Rd Tok, Tok ∗ mvcc.keyReadLocked RT NC true rt m Rd Tok true) -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                WP ((intoVal (methods rt.ty go!"RLock" rt.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

theorem mvcc.lockedIs_unlock (ld : Bool) (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF)
    (RT WT : IProp GF) (PutOk : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop) (Del :
    GoString → IProp GF) (W Dep : IProp GF) (Cmp : Prop) (Locked : mvcc.Puts → IProp GF) (P : IProp
    GF) (HF : val → IProp GF) (Rb : GMap GoString backend.BktData → IProp GF) (MW : IProp GF) (l :
    mvcc.Puts) : mvcc.batchTxSpecG bt View RT WT PutOk Del W Dep Cmp Locked P HF Rb MW ∗
    mvcc.lockedIs ld bt View W P Locked l ⊢ ∃ U, U ∗ mvcc.unlockAt bt View W P U l

    p.wv

    IProp GF) : ⊢ mvcc.lockNilSpec bt RT WT W P iprop(False) Locked

    p).leases = γ.leases

def mvcc.revToken (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  ownToks γ.revs 1

def mvcc.physNames_countable : Pos.Countable mvcc.PhysNames :=
  countableOfLeftInverse
    (fun x => ((x.nev, x.cmp, x.bucket, x.hook, x.hookFn, x.kb, x.cmeta, x.fin, x.sch, x.wk, x.wv), x.mwk, x.sx))
    (fun q =>
      have p := q.fst;
      { nev := p.fst, cmp := p.snd.fst, bucket := p.snd.snd.fst, hook := p.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        hookFn := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, kb := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, cmeta := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        fin := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, sch := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        wk := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, wv := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd,
        mwk := q.snd.fst, sx := q.snd.snd })
    mvcc.physNames_countable._proof_1

def mvcc.revMuTok (γ γp : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(dghostVar γ.rst (DFrac.own q.half) false ∗
      (∃ o, mvcc.curAt γp (DFrac.own q.half.half.half) o) ∗ ⌜γp = γ.withPhys γp.phys⌝)

def mvcc.kbRb : Option mvcc.KBReal → GMap GoString backend.BktData → IProp GF :=
  match (motive := Option mvcc.KBReal → GMap GoString backend.BktData → IProp GF) x✝ with
  | none => fun x => iprop(True)
  | some d => fun r => iprop(backend.rbPart d.γB (fun x => x = mvcc.leaseName) r ∗ ⌜mvcc.leaseParams d.P⌝)

def mvcc.metaReadTx (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (RT : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      □
        ∀ Φ,
          RT -∗
            ▷
                ((∃ Rd Tok,
                    Tok ∗
                      mvcc.rdCap Rd Tok ∗
                        □ mvcc.metaReadSpec rt false Rd Tok ∗
                          □
                            □
                              ∀ Φ,
                                Tok -∗
                                  ▷ (RT -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                                    WP
                                      ((intoVal (methods rt.ty go!"RUnlock" rt.v))
                                        (intoVal ()))
                                      {{ Φ }}) -∗
                  Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
              WP ((intoVal (methods rt.ty go!"RLock" rt.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

  | none => dghostVar hfn DFrac.discard f
  | some d => mvcc.bkHookIs d.γB f

    GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (Tok : IProp GF) (cl : Bool := false) : mvcc.keyReadLocked RT NC
    true rt m Rd Tok cl ⊢ □ mvcc.keyRangeLimSpec rt m Rd Tok cl

def mvcc.rdSplit (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (Tok :
    IProp GF) (cl : Bool) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(Tok -∗
      ∃ TokA TokB,
        TokA ∗
          TokB ∗ mvcc.rdCap Rd TokA ∗ mvcc.rdCap Rd TokB ∗ □ mvcc.keyRangeLimSpec rt m Rd TokA cl ∗ (TokA -∗ TokB -∗ Tok))

    (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF := iprop(True)) : mvcc.isTxn mw s γ trace kind crev Z ⊢ mvcc.isTxnEnd
    mw s γ trace kind crev Z

      mvcc.metaCompact γ 1 sched fin ∗ monoNatAuthOwn γ.fin 1 n ∗ ⌜mvcc.crevN (mvcc.finRev fin) ≤ n⌝ ∗ mvcc.mwSlot γ)

    (some d) = 0 ∧ (mvcc.compactJobResM (some d) ⊣⊢ True) ∧ (mvcc.kbWTSupplyM (some d) ⊣⊢ True) ∧
    (mvcc.kbSRM (some d) ⊣⊢ True)

theorem mvcc.storeReader_withPhys (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) :
    mvcc.storeReader s (γ.withPhys p) = mvcc.storeReader s γ

def mvcc.muHeld (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) (ti : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(sync.ownRWMutexRLocked (mvcc.muAddr s) (mvcc.muInv s γ) ∗
      mvcc.muInvAt s γ sync.rfrac c ∗ ∃ o, ⌜o.ti = ti⌝ ∗ mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ sync.rfrac.half o)

theorem mvcc.storeReaderC_withPhys (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) :
    mvcc.storeReaderC s (γ.withPhys p) = mvcc.storeReaderC s γ

theorem mvcc.delKey_persistent (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (k : GoString) : Persistent (mvcc.delKey γ k)

def mvcc.curAt (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (dq : DFrac) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : IProp GF :=
  dghostVar γ.cur dq (o, γ.phys)

def mvcc.metaReadSpec (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (nc : Bool) (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (Tok :
    IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ b key kn dq,
      ⌜mvcc.metaCompactKey kn⌝ →
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Meta) b DFrac.discard ∗
                Tok ∗ ownSlice key kn dq -∗
              (▷
                  ∀ ks vs,
                    Tok ∗
                        ownSlice key kn dq ∗
                          (ownSlice ks [] DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice vs [] DFrac.discard ∨
                            ∃ ksl vsl v,
                              ⌜nc = false⌝ ∗
                                ownSlice ks [ksl] DFrac.discard ∗
                                  Rd ksl kn ∗ ownSlice vs [vsl] DFrac.discard ∗ Rd vsl v ∗ ⌜mvcc.metaRevVal v⌝) -∗
                      Φ (intoVal ks, intoVal vs)) -∗
                WP
                  (((((intoVal
                            (methods rt.ty go!"UnsafeRange"
                              rt.v))
                          (intoVal b))
                        (intoVal key))
                      (intoVal slice.nil))
                    (intoVal (W64 0)))
                  {{ Φ }})

def (sealed) mvcc.noCompactor (γs : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF

def mvcc.idxSlot (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.idxReader o.ti γ.idx ∗ mvcc.storeRT γ)

def mvcc.storeTxnWriteIs (tw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend :
    List mvcc.Change) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF := iprop(True)) (ld : Bool := false) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ti bt Locked chs ps ntok Pw fw Dep,
      "Htoks" ∷ ownTokAuthDfrac γ.revs (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ntok ∗
        "%Hbudget" ∷ ⌜List.length ilog + ntok + 3 ≤ 2 ^ 63⌝ ∗
          "Htok" ∷ mvcc.revToken γ ∗
            "Htw" ∷
                typedPointsto tw
                  {
                    storeTxnCommon' :=
                      { s' := s, tx' := GoInterface.ok bt, firstRev' := W64 0, rev' := W64 0, trace' := trace },
                    tx' := GoInterface.ok bt, beginRev' := W64 (↑(List.length ilog) - 1), changes' := chs }
                  (DFrac.own 1) ∗
              "Hchs" ∷ ownSlice chs ps (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                "Hcap" ∷ ownSliceCap Loc chs (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                  "%Hps" ∷ ⌜ps.length = pend.length⌝ ∗
                    "Hkvs" ∷ mvcc.changesAre ps ilog pend ∗
                      "#Hs" ∷ mvcc.isStore s γ ∗
                        "#Hhook" ∷ mvcc.hookOk γ Pw fw ∗
                          "#Hbt" ∷
                              mvcc.batchTxSpecG bt (mvcc.bucketView γ) (mvcc.storeRT γ) (mvcc.storeWT γ)
                                (mvcc.storePutOk γ) (mvcc.delKey γ) (mvcc.storeW s γ) Dep (mvcc.storeCmp γ) Locked Pw
                                (mvcc.hookFn γ) (mvcc.storeRb γ) (mvcc.kbMW γ.kb γ.bucket) ∗
                            "#HbtB" ∷ mvcc.storeBt γ bt ∗
                              "#Hreg" ∷ mvcc.storeRegd s γ ∗
                                "Hrt" ∷ mvcc.storeRT γ ∗
                                  "Hlocked" ∷
                                      mvcc.lockedIs ld bt (mvcc.bucketView γ) (mvcc.storeW s γ) Pw Locked
                                        (mvcc.pendPuts ilog pend) ∗
                                    "Hw" ∷ mvcc.idxWriter γ.idx ilog pend ∗
                                      "Hclog" ∷ ghostVar γ.clog (Qp.half 1) ilog ∗
                                        "Hcur" ∷
                                            typedPointsto
                                              (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
                                                go!"currentRev" s)
                                              (W64 (↑(List.length ilog) - 1)) (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ∗
                                          "Hbv" ∷ mvcc.bucketViewL γ (Qp.half 1) ilog ∗
                                            "Hwv" ∷ ghostVar γ.wv 1 ilog ∗
                                              "Htko" ∷ ownToks γ.tko 1 ∗
                                                "#Hcert" ∷ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx ilog ∗
                                                  "%Hne" ∷ ⌜ilog ≠ []⌝ ∗
                                                    "Hmu" ∷ mvcc.muHeld s γ crev ti ∗
                                                      "HrevMu" ∷ sync.ownRWMutex (mvcc.revMuAddr s) (mvcc.revMuInv s γ) ∗
                                                        "Hti" ∷ mvcc.idxReader ti γ.idx ∗
                                                          "%Htrnn" ∷ ⌜trace ≠ null⌝ ∗
                                                            "Hcres" ∷ (mvcc.compactRes γ ∗ mvcc.writerLoan γ) ∗
                                                              "Hlrd" ∷ lease.lessorRdOf γ.leases ∗
                                                                "%Hcrev" ∷ ⌜-1 ≤ crev ∧ crev < ↑(List.length ilog)⌝ ∗
                                                                  "#HZ" ∷ □ Z)

def mvcc.storeCloser (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ o,
      mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ (Qp.half 1).half o ∗
        mvcc.isStopChan o.sstop ∗ mvcc.stopCloser o.sstop ∗ schedule.schedStopTok γ.sch ∗ mvcc.compactQueue γ (-1))

def mvcc.metaCompactKey (kn : GoString) : Prop :=
  kn = mvcc.schedKeyBytes ∨ kn = mvcc.finKeyBytes

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_mwk (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys p).mwk
    = p.mwk

theorem mvcc.kbHookIs_agree (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) (hfn : GName) (f f' : val) : mvcc.kbHookIs kb
    hfn f ∗ mvcc.kbHookIs kb hfn f' ⊢ ⌜f = f'⌝

theorem mvcc.writerRes_key (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (h : mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb) : mvcc.writerRes s
    γ ⊢ mvcc.mwKey γ.mwk ∗ (mvcc.mwKey γ.mwk -∗ mvcc.writerRes s γ)

theorem mvcc.txnEndPost_plain (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change)
    (puts deletes putSize : w64) (h : γ.watchQ = false) : mvcc.txnEndPost γ (mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog
    pend puts deletes putSize) ⊢ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx (mvcc.commitLog ilog pend) ∗ (if pend = [] then
    mvcc.revToken γ else True) ∗ mvcc.writerFrag γ ∗ mvcc.writerPin γ (mvcc.commitLog ilog pend)

def mvcc.viewNoCmp (γb : GName) : IProp GF :=
  mvcc.viewFk γb 0

theorem mvcc.mwSwap_of_physOk (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (h : mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb) : mvcc.physCmp
    s γ ⊢ mvcc.mwSwap (mvcc.storeW s γ) (mvcc.kbMW γ.kb γ.bucket)

def mvcc.revMuRest (s : Loc) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ v c,
      typedPointsto
          (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
            go!"currentRev" s)
          v (DFrac.own q.half) ∗
        typedPointsto
          (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
            go!"compactMainRev" s)
          c (DFrac.own q.half))

def mvcc.metaRevVal (v : GoString) : Prop :=
  ∃ x, 0 ≤ sint.Z x ∧ v = mvcc.revBytes { main := x, sub := W64 0 } false

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_sch (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys p).sch
    = p.sch

theorem mvcc.fieldShare_pin (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (dq : DFrac) (o :
    mvcc.StoreObjs) : mvcc.curAt γ dq o ∗ mvcc.fieldShare s γ q ⊢ mvcc.curAt γ dq o ∗
    mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ q o

def mvcc.isTxnWriteCore (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend :
    List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (chs : GoSlice) (ps : List Loc) (sealed : Bool)
    (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF := iprop(True)) (ld : Bool := false) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ tw ranges,
      "Hmw" ∷
          typedPointsto mw
            {
              TxnWrite' :=
                interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.storeTxnWrite.ty.PointerType (intoVal tw),
              ranges' := ranges, puts' := puts, deletes' := deletes, putSize' := putSize }
            (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        "Htw" ∷ mvcc.storeTxnWriteCore tw s γ trace ilog pend chs ps sealed crev Z ld ∗
          "Htrc" ∷ ∃ te, traceutil.ownTrace trace te)

theorem mvcc.isKeyBackendG_noNil (b : GoInterface) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT WT NC :
    IProp GF) (PutOk : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop) (Del : GoString → IProp
    GF) (W Wi Dep : IProp GF) (Cmp : Prop) (P : IProp GF) (HF : val → IProp GF) (Req : IProp GF →
    IProp GF → IProp GF) (Rb : GMap GoString backend.BktData → IProp GF) (Bt : GoInterfaceOk → IProp
    GF) (SR SRh MW HN : IProp GF) : mvcc.isKeyBackendG b View RT WT NC PutOk Del W Wi Dep Cmp P HF
    Req Rb Bt SR SRh MW HN ⊢ mvcc.isKeyBackendG b View RT WT NC PutOk Del W Wi Dep Cmp P HF Req Rb
    Bt SR SRh MW

theorem mvcc.revMuBodyL_mu (s : Loc) (γ γp : mvcc.StoreNames) (q q' : Qp) (dq : DFrac) (cm : Int)
    (hcm : -1 ≤ cm) : mvcc.revMuBodyL s γ γp q ∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"compactMainRev" s) (W64 cm) dq ∗ mvcc.crevUB
    γ.idx q' cm ⊢ mvcc.revMuBody s γ γp q ∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"compactMainRev" s) (W64 cm) dq ∗ mvcc.crevUB
    γ.idx q' cm

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_tkw (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys p).tkw
    = γ.tkw

theorem mvcc.kbSRM_of_kbSR (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : mvcc.kbSR kb ⊢ mvcc.kbSRM kb

def mvcc.keyPutOk (m : mvcc.Bucket) (l : mvcc.Puts) (k _v : GoString) : Prop :=
  List.length l < 2 ^ 56 ∧
    0 < List.length k ∧
      List.length k ≤ backend.maxKeySize ∧
        (∀ (k' v' : GoString), m !! k' = some v' → go.GoStringLt k' k) ∧
          ∀ (p : GoString × GoString), p ∈ l → go.GoStringLt p.fst k

theorem mvcc.rep_nReaders (P : IProp GF) : ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate
    sync.rwmutex.actualMaxReaders.toNat (), P) ⊢ [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate mvcc.nReaders (), P

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_cok (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys p).cok
    = γ.cok

theorem mvcc.idxCert_withPhys (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) (L : mvcc.Log) :
    mvcc.idxCert (γ.withPhys p).idx L = mvcc.idxCert γ.idx L

def mvcc.revMuAddr [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"revMu" s

theorem mvcc.storeTxnReadIs_crev (tr s : Loc) (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (trace : Loc) (γ :
    mvcc.StoreNames) (log : mvcc.Log) (rev : w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) : mvcc.storeTxnReadIs
    tr s rt trace γ log rev crev Z ⊢ ⌜-1 ≤ crev ∧ crev ≤ sint.Z rev⌝

theorem mvcc.storeFields_persistent (s : Loc) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : Persistent (mvcc.storeFields s
    o DFrac.discard)

theorem mvcc.muHeld_cmp (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) (ti : Loc) : mvcc.muHeld s γ c ti
    ⊢ typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"compactMainRev"
    s) (W64 c) (DFrac.own sync.rfrac.half) ∗ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx sync.rfrac.half.half c ∗ ⌜-1 ≤ c ∧ c
    < 2 ^ 63⌝ ∗ (typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
    go!"compactMainRev" s) (W64 c) (DFrac.own sync.rfrac.half) -∗ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx
    sync.rfrac.half.half c -∗ mvcc.muHeld s γ c ti)

theorem mvcc.keyReadLocked_range (RT NC : IProp GF) (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (Rd :
    GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (Tok : IProp GF) (cl : Bool := false) : mvcc.keyReadLocked RT NC
    true rt m Rd Tok cl ⊢ □ mvcc.keyRangeReadSpec rt m Rd Tok

theorem mvcc.revMuInv_open_cur (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (dq dq' : DFrac) (o :
    mvcc.StoreObjs) : mvcc.revMuInv s γ q ∗ dghostVar γ.rst dq false ∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq' o ⊢
    mvcc.revMuBodyL s γ γ q ∗ mvcc.revMuTok γ γ q ∗ dghostVar γ.rst dq false ∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq' o

def mvcc.muInvLag (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c cp : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop("HcmpM" ∷
        typedPointsto
          (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
            go!"compactMainRev" s)
          (W64 cp) (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ∗
      "HcrevM" ∷ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx (Qp.half 1).half c ∗
        "#HclM" ∷ mvcc.crevSafe γ c ∗ "#HpM" ∷ mvcc.crevPermAt γ c ∗ "%HcM" ∷ ⌜-1 ≤ cp ∧ cp ≤ c⌝)

def mvcc.delKey (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (k : GoString) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ c log, mvcc.crevLb γ.idx c ∗ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx log ∗ ⌜-1 ≤ c ∧ mvcc.KeyDel log c k⌝)

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_bucket (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys
    p).bucket = p.bucket

theorem mvcc.storePutOk_mono (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (M m : mvcc.Bucket) (l : mvcc.Puts) (k d :
    GoString) (hm : ∀ (k v : GoString), m !! k = some v → M !! k = some v) (h : mvcc.storePutOk γ M
    l k d) : mvcc.storePutOk γ m l k d

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_wr (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys p).wr =
    γ.wr

def mvcc.idxNames_countable : Pos.Countable mvcc.IdxNames :=
  countableOfLeftInverse (fun x => (x.hist, x.nev, x.log, x.crev, x.cmp))
    (fun p =>
      { hist := p.fst, nev := p.snd.fst, log := p.snd.snd.fst, crev := p.snd.snd.snd.fst, cmp := p.snd.snd.snd.snd })
    mvcc.idxNames_countable._proof_1

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_self (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : γ.withPhys γ.phys = γ

def mvcc.noPutCond : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop :=
  True

theorem mvcc.bucketView_halves (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (m : mvcc.Bucket) : mvcc.bucketView γ
    q m ⊣⊢ mvcc.bucketView γ q.half m ∗ mvcc.bucketView γ q.half m

theorem mvcc.batchTx_readerD (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT WT :
    IProp GF) (PutOk : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop) (Del : GoString → IProp
    GF) (W Dep : IProp GF) (Cmp : Prop) (Locked : mvcc.Puts → IProp GF) (P : IProp GF) (HF : val →
    IProp GF) (Rb : GMap GoString backend.BktData → IProp GF) (MW : IProp GF) (l : mvcc.Puts) (q :
    Qp) (m : mvcc.Bucket) : mvcc.batchTxSpecG bt View RT WT PutOk Del W Dep Cmp Locked P HF Rb MW ⊢
    mvcc.keyReaderD bt (List.foldl (fun m p => <[p.fst := p.snd]>m) m l) iprop(Locked l ∗ View q m)
    Del

theorem mvcc.hookInit_persistent (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) (f : val) : Persistent
    (mvcc.hookInit γ P f)

def mvcc.storeRegd (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  match γ.kb with
  | none => iprop(True)
  | some d => dghostVar d.gx DFrac.discard (some (s, γ))

def mvcc.storeBt (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : GoInterfaceOk → IProp GF :=
  mvcc.kbBt γ.kb

theorem mvcc.muHeld_cur (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) (ti : Loc) : mvcc.muHeld s γ c ti
    ⊢ ∃ o, ⌜o.ti = ti⌝ ∗ mvcc.curAt γ (DFrac.own sync.rfrac.half.half) o ∗ (mvcc.curAt γ (DFrac.own
    sync.rfrac.half.half) o -∗ mvcc.muHeld s γ c ti)

def mvcc.isTxnRead (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (log : mvcc.Log) (rev : w64)
    (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF := iprop(True)) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ p trw tr ti rt ranges,
      "Hmw" ∷
          typedPointsto mw
            {
              TxnWrite' :=
                interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.txnReadWrite.ty.PointerType (intoVal trw),
              ranges' := ranges, puts' := W64 0, deletes' := W64 0, putSize' := W64 0 }
            (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        "Htrw" ∷
            typedPointsto
              (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.txnReadWrite
                go!"TxnRead" trw)
              (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.storeTxnRead.ty.PointerType (intoVal tr))
              (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          "#Hs" ∷ mvcc.isStore s γ ∗
            "#Htr" ∷ mvcc.storeTxnReadIs tr s rt trace (γ.withPhys p) log rev crev Z ∗
              "Hrd" ∷ mvcc.txReader (γ.withPhys p) rt log ∗
                "Hmu" ∷ mvcc.muHeld s (γ.withPhys p) crev ti ∗
                  "HrevMu" ∷ sync.ownRWMutex (mvcc.revMuAddr s) (mvcc.revMuInv s γ) ∗
                    "Hti" ∷ mvcc.idxReader ti (γ.withPhys p).idx ∗ "Htrc" ∷ ∃ te, traceutil.ownTrace trace te)

def mvcc.mwN : Namespace :=
  (nroot.@"mvcc").@"mw"

theorem mvcc.revMuCur_fractional (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : Fractional (mvcc.revMuCur s γ)

theorem mvcc.bucketViewL_split (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q1 q2 : Qp) (L : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.bucketViewL
    γ (q1 + q2) L ⊣⊢ mvcc.bucketViewL γ q1 L ∗ mvcc.bucketViewL γ q2 L

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_idx_cmp (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys
    p).idx.cmp = p.cmp

theorem mvcc.bucketViewL_join (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (L1 L2 : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.bucketViewL γ
    q.half L1 ∗ mvcc.bucketViewL γ q.half L2 ⊢ mvcc.bucketViewL γ q L1

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_cm (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys p).cm =
    γ.cm

theorem mvcc.crevLb_neg (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) : ⊢ |==> mvcc.crevLb γ (-1)

theorem mvcc.readerPool_checkin_ws_p (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) (dq : DFrac) (o :
    mvcc.StoreObjs) : ⊢ £ 1 -∗ mvcc.readerPool γ -∗ mvcc.curAt (γ.withPhys p) dq o -∗ mvcc.idxSlot
    (γ.withPhys p) o -∗ ownToks γ.tkw 1 ={⊤}=∗ ownToks γ.tk 1 ∗ mvcc.wsDep γ ∗ mvcc.curAt
    (γ.withPhys p) dq o

theorem mvcc.keyVals_persistent (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (ks vs : GoSlice) (m :
    mvcc.Bucket) (k : GoString) : Persistent (mvcc.keyVals Rd ks vs m k)

theorem mvcc.storeTxnWriteIs_join {trace : Loc} (tw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (chs : GoSlice) (ps : List Loc) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF :=
    iprop(True)) (ld : Bool := false) : mvcc.storeTxnWriteCore tw s γ trace ilog pend chs ps false
    crev Z ld ∗ ownSlice chs ps (DFrac.own 1) ∗ mvcc.changesAre ps ilog pend ⊢ mvcc.storeTxnWriteIs
    tw s γ trace ilog pend crev Z ld

theorem mvcc.keyReadSnap_persistent (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT NC : IProp GF) (Del :
    GoString → IProp GF) (rng : Bool) (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (L : IProp GF) :
    Persistent (mvcc.keyReadSnap View RT NC Del rng rt m L)

def mvcc.stopCloser (c : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γc, ownBroadcastChan c γc iprop(True) Broadcast.Pending)

def mvcc.txReader (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (log : mvcc.Log) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ m m' Rd Tok,
      "#Hsnap" ∷ mvcc.keyReadLocked (mvcc.storeRT γ) iprop(False) false rt m' Rd Tok ∗
        "#Hthin" ∷ mvcc.snapThin m m' (mvcc.delKey γ) ∗
          "Htok" ∷ Tok ∗ "Hwr" ∷ mvcc.wDep γ ∗ "Htko" ∷ ownToks γ.tko 1 ∗ "%Hsub" ∷ ⌜(mvcc.bucketMap log).Subseteq m⌝)

def mvcc.Puts : Type :=
  List (GoString × GoString)

theorem mvcc.keyCleanRead_persistent (b : GoInterface) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT NC :
    IProp GF) : Persistent (mvcc.keyCleanRead b View RT NC)

theorem mvcc.curAt_pin (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) (dq dq' : DFrac) (o o' :
    mvcc.StoreObjs) : mvcc.curAt γ dq o ∗ mvcc.curAt (γ.withPhys p) dq' o' ⊢ ⌜o' = o ∧ p = γ.phys⌝

    mvcc.crevUB (γ.withPhys p).idx q c = mvcc.crevUB γ.idx q c

theorem mvcc.keyReadLocked_meta (RT NC : IProp GF) (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (Rd :
    GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (Tok : IProp GF) (cl : Bool := false) : mvcc.keyReadLocked RT NC
    true rt m Rd Tok cl ⊢ □ (NC -∗ NC ∗ □ mvcc.metaReadSpec rt true Rd Tok)

def mvcc.storeTxnReadIs (tr s : Loc) (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (trace : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (log :
    mvcc.Log) (rev : w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF := iprop(True)) : IProp GF :=
  iprop("#Hs" ∷
        typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.storeTxnCommon go!"s" (mvcc.txCommon tr)) s
          DFrac.discard ∗
      "#Htxc" ∷
          typedPointsto
            (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.storeTxnCommon go!"tx" (mvcc.txCommon tr))
            (GoInterface.ok rt) DFrac.discard ∗
        "#HfirstRev" ∷
            typedPointsto
              (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.storeTxnCommon
                go!"firstRev" (mvcc.txCommon tr))
              (W64 crev) DFrac.discard ∗
          "#Hrev" ∷
              typedPointsto
                (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.storeTxnCommon go!"rev"
                  (mvcc.txCommon tr))
                rev DFrac.discard ∗
            "#Htrace" ∷
                typedPointsto
                  (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.storeTxnCommon go!"trace"
                    (mvcc.txCommon tr))
                  trace DFrac.discard ∗
              "#Htx" ∷
                  typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.storeTxnRead go!"tx" tr)
                    (GoInterface.ok rt) DFrac.discard ∗
                "#Hcert" ∷ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx log ∗
                  "#Hnev" ∷ mvcc.idxNevLb γ.idx log ∗
                    "%Hne" ∷ ⌜log ≠ []⌝ ∗
                      "%Hrev" ∷ ⌜rev = W64 (↑(List.length log) - 1)⌝ ∗
                        "%Htrnn" ∷ ⌜trace ≠ null⌝ ∗ "%Hcrev" ∷ ⌜-1 ≤ crev ∧ crev < ↑(List.length log)⌝ ∗ "#HZ" ∷ □ Z)

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_hookFn (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys
    p).hookFn = p.hookFn

  iprop(⌜c = -1⌝ ∨ ∃ Perm, mvcc.crevPermIs γ Perm ∗ □ Perm c)

    ∗ mvcc.writerRes s γ ={E}=∗ mvcc.writerReg s γ

def mvcc.muInvAt (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (c : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop("HcmpM" ∷
        typedPointsto
          (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
            go!"compactMainRev" s)
          (W64 c) (DFrac.own q.half) ∗
      "HcrevM" ∷ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx q.half.half c ∗
        "#HclM" ∷ mvcc.crevSafe γ c ∗ "#HpM" ∷ mvcc.crevPermAt γ c ∗ "%HcM" ∷ ⌜-1 ≤ c⌝)

  if pend = [] ∨ γ.watchQ = false then iprop(True) else mvcc.logQ γ (ilog ++ [pend])

def mvcc.kbBt : Option mvcc.KBReal → GoInterfaceOk → IProp GF :=
  match (motive := Option mvcc.KBReal → GoInterfaceOk → IProp GF) x✝ with
  | none => fun x => iprop(True)
  | some d => mvcc.bkBt d.be

theorem mvcc.ghostVar_join_halves {A : Type} [Pos.Countable A] (γ : GName) (a b : A) : ghostVar γ
    (Qp.half 1) a ∗ ghostVar γ (Qp.half 1) b ⊢ ghostVar γ 1 a ∗ ⌜a = b⌝

def mvcc.kbReq (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : IProp GF → IProp GF → IProp GF :=
  match (motive := Option mvcc.KBReal → IProp GF → IProp GF → IProp GF) kb with
  | none => fun X Y => iprop(□ (X -∗ Y))
  | some d => mvcc.bkReq d.γB d.P d.be

    GF) (HF : val → IProp GF) (h : mvcc.storeCmp γ) : mvcc.isKeyBackendG b (mvcc.bucketView γ)
    (mvcc.storeRT γ) (mvcc.storeWT γ) iprop(False) (mvcc.storePutOk γ) (mvcc.delKey γ) (mvcc.storeW
    s γ) (mvcc.kbWi γ.kb) Dep (mvcc.storeCmp γ) P HF (mvcc.storeReq γ) (mvcc.storeRb γ)
    (mvcc.storeBt γ) (mvcc.kbSR γ.kb) (mvcc.kbSRh γ.kb) (mvcc.kbMW γ.kb γ.bucket) (mvcc.kbHookNil
    γ.kb) ⊢ mvcc.isKeyBackendG b (mvcc.bucketView γ) (mvcc.storeRT γ) (mvcc.storeWT γ) iprop(False)
    (mvcc.storePutOk γ) (mvcc.delKey γ) (mvcc.storeW s γ) (mvcc.kbWi γ.kb) Dep True P HF
    (mvcc.storeReq γ) (mvcc.storeRb γ) (mvcc.storeBt γ) (mvcc.kbSR γ.kb) (mvcc.kbSRh γ.kb)
    (mvcc.kbMW γ.kb γ.bucket) (mvcc.kbHookNil γ.kb)

    £ 1 -∗ mvcc.readerPool γ -∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq o -∗ ownToks γ.tk 1 -∗ mvcc.retiredAt γ n ={⊤}=∗
    mvcc.storeRT γ ∗ mvcc.retiredAt γ (n + 1) ∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq o

def mvcc.kbCmpM (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : Prop :=
  match kb with
  | none => True
  | some d => d.cm = true

def mvcc.poolBody (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ k j w r,
      ownTokAuth γ.tk k ∗
        ownTokAuth γ.tko j ∗
          ownTokAuth γ.tkw w ∗
            ghostVar γ.tkr (Qp.half 1) r ∗
              ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate k (), mvcc.idxSlot γ o) ∗
                ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate j (), mvcc.wDep γ) ∗
                  ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate w (), mvcc.wsDep γ) ∗ ⌜k + j + w + r = mvcc.nReaders⌝)

def mvcc.lateReg (gx : GName) : IProp GF :=
  dghostVar gx (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) none

def mvcc.compactJobResM (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : IProp GF :=
  if mvcc.kbCmpM kb then iprop(mvcc.kbRT kb ∗ mvcc.kbSR kb) else iprop(True)

def mvcc.metaPutCap (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (X Y : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ b key val k v,
        ⌜mvcc.metaCompactKey k ∧ mvcc.metaRevVal v⌝ →
          □
            ∀ Φ,
              typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Meta) b DFrac.discard ∗
                  X ∗ ownSlice key k DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice val v DFrac.discard -∗
                ▷ (Y -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                  WP
                    ((((intoVal (methods bt.ty go!"UnsafePut" bt.v))
                          (intoVal b))
                        (intoVal key))
                      (intoVal val))
                    {{ Φ }})

    mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (chs : GoSlice) (ps : List Loc) (hne : pend ≠ []) (crev :
    Int) (Z : IProp GF := iprop(True)) (ld : Bool := false) : ⊢ mvcc.storeTxnWriteCore tw s γ trace

def mvcc.revMuBodyL (s : Loc) (γ γp : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ log ntok c cp,
      "Hrev" ∷
          typedPointsto
            (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
              go!"currentRev" s)
            (W64 (↑(List.length log) - 1)) (DFrac.own q.half) ∗
        "Hclog" ∷ ghostVar γ.clog q.half log ∗
          "#Hcert" ∷ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx log ∗
            "#Hnev" ∷ mvcc.idxNevLb γp.idx log ∗
              "#Hok" ∷ mvcc.certOk γ log ∗
                "%Hne" ∷ ⌜log ≠ []⌝ ∗
                  "Hbucket" ∷ mvcc.bucketViewL γp q.half log ∗
                    "Htoks" ∷ ownTokAuthDfrac γ.revs (DFrac.own q.half) ntok ∗
                      "%Hbudget" ∷ ⌜List.length log + ntok + 3 ≤ 2 ^ 63⌝ ∗
                        "Hlog" ∷ mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.idx (mvcc.revQ γ q) log ∗
                          "Hcmp" ∷
                              typedPointsto
                                (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
                                  go!"compactMainRev"
                                  s)
                                (W64 cp) (DFrac.own q.half) ∗
                            "Hcrev" ∷ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx q.half.half c ∗
                              "#Hperm" ∷ mvcc.crevPermAt γ c ∗
                                "Hlag" ∷ mvcc.revLag γ q c cp ∗ "%Hc" ∷ ⌜-1 ≤ c ∧ c < ↑(List.length log)⌝)

    ∗ mvcc.hookIs γ P f ∗ mvcc.hookIs γ P' f' ⊢ |={E}=> ⌜f = f'⌝ ∗ □ (P -∗ P') ∗ □ (P' -∗ P)

    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"kvindex" s) (interface.mkOk

    sync.rfrac.half) -∗ mvcc.muHeld s γ c ti)
