theorem mvcc.metaReadSpec_persistent (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (nc : Bool) (Rd : GoSlice → GoString →
    IProp GF) (Tok : IProp GF) : Persistent (mvcc.metaReadSpec rt nc Rd Tok)

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_idx_nev (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys
    p).idx.nev = p.nev

def mvcc.mwSwap (W MW : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□ (W ∗ £ 1 ={⊤}=∗ MW ∗ (MW ={⊤}=∗ W)))

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_withPhys (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p p' : mvcc.PhysNames) :
    (γ.withPhys p).withPhys p' = γ.withPhys p'

theorem mvcc.batchTxSpecG_persistent (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT
    WT : IProp GF) (PutOk : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop) (Del : GoString →
    IProp GF) (W Dep : IProp GF) (Cmp : Prop) (Locked : mvcc.Puts → IProp GF) (P : IProp GF) (HF :
    val → IProp GF) (Rb : GMap GoString backend.BktData → IProp GF) (MW HN : IProp GF) : Persistent
    (mvcc.batchTxSpecG bt View RT WT PutOk Del W Dep Cmp Locked P HF Rb MW HN)

theorem mvcc.bucketLog_append (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (m :
    mvcc.Bucket) (hne : ilog ≠ []) : mvcc.bucketLog γ ilog m ⊢ mvcc.bucketLog γ (ilog ++ [pend])
    (List.foldl (fun m p => <[p.fst := p.snd]>m) m (mvcc.pendPuts ilog pend))

def mvcc.writerReg (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  inv mvcc.regN iprop(mvcc.storeRegd s γ ∨ mvcc.kbRegRight γ.kb ∗ mvcc.writerRes s γ)

def mvcc.kbSRM (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : IProp GF :=
  if mvcc.kbCmpM kb then mvcc.kbSR kb else iprop(True)

def mvcc.storeTxnWriteCore (tw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend
    : List mvcc.Change) (chs : GoSlice) (ps : List Loc) (sealed : Bool) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF
    := iprop(True)) (ld : Bool := false) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ti bt Locked ntok Pw fw Dep,
      "Htoks" ∷ ownTokAuthDfrac γ.revs (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ntok ∗
        "%Hbudget" ∷ ⌜List.length ilog + ntok + 3 ≤ 2 ^ 63⌝ ∗
          "Htok" ∷ mvcc.revToken γ ∗
            "Htw" ∷
                typedPointsto tw
                  {
                    storeTxnCommon' :=
                      { s' := s, tx' := GoInterface.ok bt, firstRev' := W64 0, rev' := W64 0, trace' := trace },
                    tx' := GoInterface.ok bt, beginRev' := W64 (↑(List.length ilog) - 1), changes' := chs }
                  (DFrac.own 1) ∗
              "Hcap" ∷ ownSliceCap Loc chs (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                "%Hps" ∷ ⌜ps.length = pend.length ∧ ps.length = sint.nat chs.len ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z chs.len⌝ ∗
                  "#Hs" ∷ mvcc.isStore s γ ∗
                    "#Hhook" ∷ mvcc.hookOk γ Pw fw ∗
                      "#Hbt" ∷
                          mvcc.batchTxSpecG bt (mvcc.bucketView γ) (mvcc.storeRT γ) (mvcc.storeWT γ) (mvcc.storePutOk γ)
                            (mvcc.delKey γ) (mvcc.storeW s γ) Dep (mvcc.storeCmp γ) Locked Pw (mvcc.hookFn γ)
                            (mvcc.storeRb γ) (mvcc.kbMW γ.kb γ.bucket) ∗
                        "#HbtB" ∷ mvcc.storeBt γ bt ∗
                          "#Hreg" ∷ mvcc.storeRegd s γ ∗
                            "Hrt" ∷ mvcc.storeRT γ ∗
                              "Hlocked" ∷
                                  mvcc.lockedIs ld bt (mvcc.bucketView γ) (mvcc.storeW s γ) Pw Locked
                                    (mvcc.pendPuts ilog pend) ∗
                                "Hw" ∷ mvcc.idxWriterB γ.idx ilog pend sealed ∗
                                  "Hclog" ∷ ghostVar γ.clog (Qp.half 1) ilog ∗
                                    "Hcur" ∷
                                        typedPointsto
                                          (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
                                            go!"currentRev" s)
                                          (W64 (↑(List.length ilog) - 1)) (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ∗
                                      "Hbv" ∷ mvcc.bucketViewL γ (Qp.half 1) ilog ∗
                                        "Hwv" ∷ ghostVar γ.wv 1 ilog ∗
                                          "Htko" ∷ ownToks γ.tko 1 ∗
                                            "#Hcert" ∷ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx ilog ∗
                                              "%Hne" ∷ ⌜ilog ≠ []⌝ ∗
                                                "Hmu" ∷ mvcc.muHeld s γ crev ti ∗
                                                  "HrevMu" ∷ sync.ownRWMutex (mvcc.revMuAddr s) (mvcc.revMuInv s γ) ∗
                                                    "Hti" ∷ mvcc.idxReader ti γ.idx ∗
                                                      "%Htrnn" ∷ ⌜trace ≠ null⌝ ∗
                                                        "Hcres" ∷ (mvcc.compactRes γ ∗ mvcc.writerLoan γ) ∗
                                                          "Hlrd" ∷ lease.lessorRdOf γ.leases ∗
                                                            "%Hcrev" ∷ ⌜-1 ≤ crev ∧ crev < ↑(List.length ilog)⌝ ∗
                                                              "#HZ" ∷ □ Z)

def mvcc.rbDel (r : GMap GoString backend.BktData) (n k : GoString) : GMap GoString backend.BktData
    :=
  <[n := GMap.delete k ((r !! n).getD ∅)]>r

theorem mvcc.storeFields_split (s : Loc) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) (q1 q2 : Qp) : mvcc.storeFields s o
    (DFrac.own (q1 + q2)) ⊣⊢ mvcc.storeFields s o (DFrac.own q1) ∗ mvcc.storeFields s o (DFrac.own
    q2)

theorem mvcc.snapThin_insert (m m' : mvcc.Bucket) (k v : GoString) (Del : GoString → IProp GF) :
    mvcc.snapThin m m' Del ⊢ mvcc.snapThin (<[k := v]>m) (<[k := v]>m') Del

def mvcc.isLessor (le : GoInterface) (γl : GName) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ lp,
      ⌜le = lease.lessorIface lp⌝ ∗
        lease.lessorPin γl lp ∗
          (□
              ∀ item L I,
                □
                  ∀ Φ,
                    lease.lessorRd lp γl ∗ lease.leaseOwn γl L I -∗
                      ▷ (lease.lessorRd lp γl ∗ lease.leaseOwn γl L I -∗ Φ (intoVal ((I !! item).getD (W64 0)))) -∗
                        WP
                          ((intoVal
                              (methods go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.lessor.ty.PointerType
                                go!"GetLease" (intoVal lp)))
                            (intoVal item))
                          {{ Φ }}) ∗
            (□
                ∀ id items l dq L I,
                  □
                    ∀ Φ,
                      lease.leaseOwn γl L I ∗
                          ⌜id ∈ L⌝ ∗
                            ⌜∀ (it : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.LeaseItem),
                                  it ∈ l → I !! it = none ∨ I !! it = some id⌝ ∗
                              ⌜∀ (it : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.LeaseItem),
                                    it ∈ l → ↑(List.length it.Key') < 2 ^ 63 - 1⌝ ∗
                                ownSlice items l dq -∗
                        ▷
                            (lease.leaseOwn γl L (lease.insertAll I l id) ∗ ownSlice items l dq -∗
                              Φ (intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                          WP
                            (((intoVal
                                  (methods go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.lessor.ty.PointerType
                                    go!"Attach" (intoVal lp)))
                                (intoVal id))
                              (intoVal items))
                            {{ Φ }}) ∗
              (□
                  ∀ id items l dq L I,
                    □
                      ∀ Φ,
                        lease.leaseOwn γl L I ∗
                            ⌜l ≠ []⌝ ∗
                              ⌜∀ (it : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.LeaseItem), it ∈ l → I !! it = some id⌝ ∗
                                ownSlice items l dq -∗
                          ▷
                              (lease.leaseOwn γl L (lease.deleteAll I l) ∗ ownSlice items l dq -∗
                                Φ (intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                            WP
                              (((intoVal
                                    (methods go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.lessor.ty.PointerType
                                      go!"Detach" (intoVal lp)))
                                  (intoVal id))
                                (intoVal items))
                              {{ Φ }}) ∗
                □
                  ∀ f0 f,
                    □
                      ∀ Φ,
                        lease.rdOwn γl f0 -∗
                          ▷ (lease.rdOwn γl f -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                            WP
                              ((intoVal
                                  (methods go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.lease.lessor.ty.PointerType
                                    go!"SetRangeDeleter"
                                    (intoVal lp)))
                                (intoVal f))
                              {{ Φ }})

theorem mvcc.storeTxnWriteCore_wf {trace : Loc} (tw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (chs : GoSlice) (ps : List Loc) (b : Bool) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF
    := iprop(True)) (ld : Bool := false) : mvcc.storeTxnWriteCore tw s γ trace ilog pend chs ps b
    crev Z ld ⊢ mvcc.storeTxnWriteCore tw s γ trace ilog pend chs ps b crev Z ld ∗ ⌜mvcc.IdxWf ilog
    pend ∧ ps.length = pend.length ∧ ps.length = sint.nat chs.len ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z chs.len ∧ ilog ≠ []⌝

theorem mvcc.muInvLag_at (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : mvcc.muInvLag s γ c c ⊣⊢
    mvcc.muInvAt s γ 1 c

theorem mvcc.readerPool_checkout_ws_p (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) (dq : DFrac) (o :
    mvcc.StoreObjs) : ⊢ £ 1 -∗ mvcc.readerPool γ -∗ mvcc.curAt (γ.withPhys p) dq o -∗ ownToks γ.tk 1
    -∗ mvcc.wsDep γ ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.idxSlot (γ.withPhys p) o ∗ ownToks γ.tkw 1 ∗ mvcc.curAt (γ.withPhys
    p) dq o

theorem mvcc.keyReaderD_persistent (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (R : IProp GF) (Del :
    GoString → IProp GF) : Persistent (mvcc.keyReaderD rt m R Del)

def mvcc.logLent (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) : Option (Qp × mvcc.Log) → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | some (q, L) => mvcc.idxLogAuth γ q L
  | none => iprop(True)

def mvcc.kbRegRight (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : IProp GF :=
  match kb with
  | none => iprop(True)
  | some d => mvcc.lateReg d.gx

theorem mvcc.storeRegd_persistent (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : Persistent (mvcc.storeRegd s γ)

theorem mvcc.storeRegd_timeless (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : Timeless (mvcc.storeRegd s γ)

def mvcc.delKeyI (γi : mvcc.IdxNames) (k : GoString) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ c log, mvcc.crevLb γi c ∗ mvcc.idxCert γi log ∗ ⌜-1 ≤ c ∧ mvcc.KeyDel log c k⌝)

def mvcc.storeReq (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF → IProp GF → IProp GF :=
  mvcc.kbReq γ.kb

theorem mvcc.bucketLog_sub (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L : mvcc.Log) (m : mvcc.Bucket) : mvcc.bucketLog γ
    L m ⊢ ⌜∀ (k v : GoString), m !! k = some v → mvcc.bucketMap L !! k = some v⌝

theorem mvcc.crevFrozen_lb (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) (hc : -1 ≤ c) : ⊢ mvcc.crevFrozen γ -∗
    mvcc.crevLb γ.idx c ={⊤}=∗ ⌜c = -1⌝

def mvcc.authBI : backend.BucketInfo :=
  { id := W64 20, name := go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.authName, safe := false }

def mvcc.writerLoan (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  if mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb then iprop(True) else iprop(mvcc.kbNoCmp γ.kb γ.bucket ∗ mvcc.kbNoDel γ.kb)

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_cur (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys p).cur
    = γ.cur

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_revs (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys
    p).revs = γ.revs

theorem mvcc.retiredAt_timeless (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (r : Nat) : Timeless (mvcc.retiredAt γ r)

def mvcc.revMuInv (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ m, dghostVar γ.rst (DFrac.own q.half) m ∗ if m = true then mvcc.revMuRest s q else mvcc.revMuCur s γ q)

theorem mvcc.snapThin_trans (m1 m2 m3 : mvcc.Bucket) (Del : GoString → IProp GF) : mvcc.snapThin m1
    m2 Del ∗ mvcc.snapThin m2 m3 Del ⊢ mvcc.snapThin m1 m3 Del

theorem mvcc.storeW_pending (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : ⊢ mvcc.storeW s γ ∗ mvcc.kbRegRight
    γ.kb ∗ mvcc.writerRes s γ ==∗ mvcc.writerRes s γ ∗ mvcc.storeRegd s γ

theorem mvcc.keyReaderD_thin (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (mv m : mvcc.Bucket) (R : IProp GF) (Del :
    GoString → IProp GF) : mvcc.keyReaderD rt m R Del ∗ mvcc.snapThin mv m Del ⊢ mvcc.keyReaderD rt
    mv R Del

def mvcc.StoreNames.phys (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : mvcc.PhysNames :=
  { nev := γ.idx.nev, cmp := γ.idx.cmp, bucket := γ.bucket, hook := γ.hook, hookFn := γ.hookFn, kb := γ.kb,
    cmeta := γ.cmeta, fin := γ.fin, sch := γ.sch, wk := γ.wk, wv := γ.wv, mwk := γ.mwk, sx := γ.sx }

def mvcc.keyRangeSpec (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF)
    (Tok : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ b key k dq,
      □
        ∀ Φ,
          typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Key) b DFrac.discard ∗
              Tok ∗ ownSlice key k dq -∗
            (▷ ∀ ks vs, Tok ∗ ownSlice key k dq ∗ mvcc.keyVals Rd ks vs m k -∗ Φ (intoVal ks, intoVal vs)) -∗
              WP
                (((((intoVal
                          (methods rt.ty go!"UnsafeRange" rt.v))
                        (intoVal b))
                      (intoVal key))
                    (intoVal slice.nil))
                  (intoVal (W64 0)))
                {{ Φ }})

theorem mvcc.isTxnWrite_cert (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) (ld : Bool) :
    mvcc.isTxnWrite mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev Z ld ⊢ mvcc.isTxnWrite mw s γ
    trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev Z ld ∗ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx ilog

theorem mvcc.curAt_withPhys_agree (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p1 p2 : mvcc.PhysNames) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac)
    (o1 o2 : mvcc.StoreObjs) : mvcc.curAt (γ.withPhys p1) dq1 o1 ∗ mvcc.curAt (γ.withPhys p2) dq2 o2
    ⊢ ⌜o1 = o2 ∧ p1 = p2⌝

theorem mvcc.compactJobResM_on (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) (h : mvcc.kbCmpM kb) : mvcc.compactJobResM
    kb ⊣⊢ mvcc.kbRT kb ∗ mvcc.kbSR kb

theorem mvcc.bkHookIs_persistent (γB : backend.BNames) (f : val) : Persistent (mvcc.bkHookIs γB f)

def mvcc.muAddr [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"mu" s

theorem mvcc.fieldShareAt_phys (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) :
    mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ q o ⊢ □ mvcc.physOk s γ o

theorem mvcc.writerInv_withPhys (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) :
    mvcc.writerInv s (γ.withPhys p) = mvcc.writerInv s γ

def mvcc.fieldShare (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ p o, mvcc.fieldShareAt s (γ.withPhys p) q o)

theorem mvcc.crevUB_split (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (q1 q2 : Qp) (c : Int) : mvcc.crevUB γ (q1 + q2) c ⊣⊢
    mvcc.crevUB γ q1 c ∗ mvcc.crevUB γ q2 c

theorem mvcc.stopPay_of_done (γx : GName) (γs : schedule.SchedNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) (γc :
    ChanNames) : mvcc.stopPayAt γx γs o ∗ ownBroadcastChan o.sstop γc iprop(True) Broadcast.Done ⊢
    schedule.schedPay γs

def mvcc.storeBackendT (b : GoInterface) (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) : IProp GF
    :=
  mvcc.isKeyBackendG b (mvcc.bucketView γ) (mvcc.storeRT γ) (mvcc.storeWT γ) (mvcc.kbNoCmp γ.kb γ.bucket)
    (mvcc.storePutOk γ) (mvcc.delKey γ) (mvcc.storeW s γ) (mvcc.kbWi γ.kb) iprop(True) (mvcc.storeCmp γ) P (mvcc.hookFn γ)
    (mvcc.storeReq γ) (mvcc.storeRb γ) (mvcc.storeBt γ) (mvcc.kbSR γ.kb) (mvcc.kbSRh γ.kb) (mvcc.kbMW γ.kb γ.bucket)
    (mvcc.kbHookNil γ.kb)

theorem mvcc.isTxnRead_crev (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (log : mvcc.Log) (rev :
    w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) : mvcc.isTxnRead mw s γ trace log rev crev Z ⊢ ⌜-1 ≤ crev ∧
    crev ≤ sint.Z rev⌝

theorem mvcc.physOk_persistent (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : Persistent
    (mvcc.physOk s γ o)

theorem mvcc.noCompactor_of_frozen (γs : mvcc.StoreNames) : mvcc.crevFrozen γs ⊢ mvcc.noCompactor γs

theorem mvcc.physCmp_persistent (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : Persistent (mvcc.physCmp s γ)

def mvcc.compactedAt (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (rev : Int) : IProp GF :=
  monoNatLbOwn γ.fin (mvcc.crevN rev)

theorem mvcc.storeTxnWriteIs_leaseDel {trace : Loc} (tw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog :
    mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) : mvcc.storeTxnWriteIs tw s γ
    trace ilog pend crev Z ⊢ ∃ bt, mvcc.storeBt γ bt ∗ ∀ b key k dq r Φ, typedPointsto (globalAddr
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Lease) b DFrac.discard -∗ ownSlice key k dq -∗
    mvcc.storeRb γ r -∗ ▷ (mvcc.storeTxnWriteIs tw s γ trace ilog pend crev Z true -∗ ownSlice key k
    dq -∗ mvcc.storeRb γ (mvcc.rbDel r mvcc.leaseName k) -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP (((intoVal
    (methods bt.ty go!"UnsafeDelete" bt.v)) (intoVal b)) (intoVal key)) {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.bucketViewL (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (L : mvcc.Log) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ m, mvcc.bucketView γ q m ∗ mvcc.bucketLog γ L m)

def mvcc.crevSafe (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ log, mvcc.idxCert γ.idx log ∗ ⌜c < ↑(List.length log)⌝)

def mvcc.txCommonW [GoSemanticsFunctions] (tw : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.storeTxnWrite
    go!"storeTxnCommon" tw

def mvcc.mwSlot (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  if mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb then mvcc.mwKey γ.mwk else iprop(True)

theorem mvcc.readerPool_persistent (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : Persistent (mvcc.readerPool γ)

theorem mvcc.logLent_agree (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (q0 : Qp) (log : mvcc.Log) (oa : Option (Qp ×
    mvcc.Log)) : mvcc.idxLogAuth γ q0 log ∗ mvcc.logLent γ oa ⊢ mvcc.idxLogAuth γ q0 log ∗
    mvcc.logLent γ oa ∗ ⌜∀ (q : Qp) (L : mvcc.Log), oa = some (q, L) → log = L⌝

theorem mvcc.crevPermAt_of (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (Perm : Int → IProp GF) (c : Int) : mvcc.crevPermIs
    γ Perm ∗ □ Perm c ⊢ mvcc.crevPermAt γ c

def mvcc.keyReadSnap (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT NC : IProp GF) (Del : GoString → IProp
    GF) (rng : Bool) (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (L : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ q,
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            L ∗ View q m -∗
              ▷
                  ((View q m ∗ ∃ m' Rd Tok, Tok ∗ mvcc.keyReadLocked RT NC rng rt m' Rd Tok ∗ mvcc.snapThin m m' Del) -∗
                    Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                WP ((intoVal (methods rt.ty go!"RLock" rt.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

def mvcc.keyCleanRead (b : GoInterface) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT NC : IProp GF) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ bi,
      ⌜b = GoInterface.ok bi⌝ ∗
        □
          ∀ q m,
            □
              ∀ Φ,
                View q m ∗ RT -∗
                  (▷
                      ∀ rt,
                        (View q m ∗ ∃ L, L ∗ mvcc.keyReadSnapC View RT NC rt m L) -∗ Φ (intoVal (GoInterface.ok rt))) -∗
                    WP ((intoVal (methods bi.ty go!"ReadTx" bi.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

def mvcc.nReaders : Nat :=
  backend.rdStockN

def mvcc.kbReal_countable : Pos.Countable mvcc.KBReal :=
  countableOfLeftInverse (fun x => (x.γB, x.BT, x.hookMax, x.limit, x.be, x.gx, x.cm))
    (fun p =>
      { γB := p.fst, BT := p.snd.fst, hookMax := p.snd.snd.fst, limit := p.snd.snd.snd.fst, be := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        gx := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, cm := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd })
    mvcc.kbReal_countable._proof_1

theorem mvcc.storePutOk_next (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (t :
    Bool) (d : GoString) (hlen : List.length ilog < 2 ^ 63) (hcs : ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈
    ilog → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (hp : pend.length + 1 < mvcc.putMax γ) : mvcc.storePutOk γ
    (mvcc.bucketMap ilog) (mvcc.pendPuts ilog pend) (mvcc.revBytes { main := W64 ↑(List.length
    ilog), sub := W64 ↑pend.length } t) d

theorem mvcc.revMuBodyL_noLag (s : Loc) (γ γp : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) : mvcc.revMuBodyL s γ γp q
    ⊢ ghostVar γ.wsd q.half.half () ∨ mvcc.revMuBody s γ γp q

def mvcc.mwRest (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  if mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb then ghostVar γ.mwk (Qp.half 1) true else iprop(True)

theorem mvcc.muHeld_frozen (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (crev : Int) (ti : Loc) : ⊢
    mvcc.crevFrozen γ -∗ mvcc.muHeld s γ crev ti ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.muHeld s γ crev ti ∗ ⌜crev = -1⌝

def mvcc.storeReader (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  mvcc.storeReaderC s γ

def mvcc.kbPutMax (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : Nat :=
  match kb with
  | none => 2 ^ 63
  | some val => 2 ^ 56

theorem mvcc.isTxnWrite_leaseDel (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) :
    mvcc.isTxnWrite mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev Z ⊢ ∃ bt, mvcc.storeBt γ bt ∗ ∀
    b key k dq r Φ, typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Lease) b
    DFrac.discard -∗ ownSlice key k dq -∗ mvcc.storeRb γ r -∗ ▷ (mvcc.isTxnWrite mw s γ trace ilog
    pend puts deletes putSize crev Z true -∗ ownSlice key k dq -∗ mvcc.storeRb γ (mvcc.rbDel r
    mvcc.leaseName k) -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP (((intoVal (methods bt.ty go!"UnsafeDelete" bt.v))
    (intoVal b)) (intoVal key)) {{ Φ }}

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_wsd (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys p).wsd
    = γ.wsd

def mvcc.kbMW (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) (γb : GName) : IProp GF :=
  match kb with
  | none => iprop(∃ f, mvcc.viewFk γb f)
  | some d => iprop(∃ f, backend.fkOwn d.γB f)

theorem mvcc.crevPermIs_alloc (Perm : Int → IProp GF) : ⊢ |==> ∃ g, savedPredOwn g DFrac.discard fun
    c => iprop(□ Perm c)

theorem mvcc.storeTxnReadIs_persistent (tr s : Loc) (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (trace : Loc) (γ :
    mvcc.StoreNames) (log : mvcc.Log) (rev : w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) : Persistent
    (mvcc.storeTxnReadIs tr s rt trace γ log rev crev Z)

theorem mvcc.revMuInv_open_pin (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) (q : Qp) (dq dq'
    : DFrac) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : mvcc.revMuInv s γ q ∗ dghostVar γ.rst dq false ∗ mvcc.curAt
    (γ.withPhys p) dq' o ⊢ mvcc.revMuBodyL s γ (γ.withPhys p) q ∗ mvcc.revMuTok γ (γ.withPhys p) q ∗
    dghostVar γ.rst dq false ∗ mvcc.curAt (γ.withPhys p) dq' o

def mvcc.hookOk (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) (f : val) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.hookP γ P ∗ mvcc.hookFn γ f)

theorem mvcc.storeW_register (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : ⊢ mvcc.kbWi γ.kb ∗ mvcc.kbRegRight
    γ.kb ∗ mvcc.writerRes s γ ==∗ mvcc.storeW s γ ∗ mvcc.storeRegd s γ

def mvcc.kbView (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) (γb : GName) (q : Qp) (m : mvcc.Bucket) : IProp GF :=
  match kb with
  | none => ghostMapAuth γb q m
  | some d => mvcc.bkView d.γB q m

def mvcc.schedNames_countable : Pos.Countable schedule.SchedNames :=
  countableOfLeftInverse (fun x => (x.run, x.jobs, x.pay))
    (fun p => { run := p.fst, jobs := p.snd.fst, pay := p.snd.snd }) mvcc.schedNames_countable._proof_1

structure mvcc.StoreObjs : Type where
  b : GoInterface
  ti : Loc
  ssched : GoInterface
  sstop : Loc

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_hook (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys
    p).hook = p.hook

theorem mvcc.isKeyBackendG_wand {b : GoInterface} {View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF} {RT WT NC :
    IProp GF} {PutOk : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop} {Del : GoString → IProp
    GF} {W Wi Dep : IProp GF} {Cmp : Prop} {P : IProp GF} {HF : val → IProp GF} {γ :
    mvcc.StoreNames} {Rb : GMap GoString backend.BktData → IProp GF} {Bt : GoInterfaceOk → IProp GF}
    {SR SRh MW HN : IProp GF} : mvcc.isKeyBackendG b View RT WT NC PutOk Del W Wi Dep Cmp P HF
    (mvcc.storeReq γ) Rb Bt SR SRh MW HN ⊢ mvcc.isKeyBackendG b View RT WT NC PutOk Del W Wi Dep Cmp
    P HF (fun X Y => iprop(□ (X -∗ Y))) Rb Bt SR SRh MW

theorem mvcc.crevPermAt_none (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : ⊢ mvcc.crevPermAt γ (-1)

structure mvcc.KBReal : Type where
  γB : backend.BNames
  BT : GMap GoString w64
  hookMax : Nat
  limit : w64
  be : Loc
  gx : GName
  cm : Bool

theorem mvcc.kbPutMax_le (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : mvcc.kbPutMax kb ≤ 2 ^ 63

theorem mvcc.curAt_discard_persistent (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : Persistent
    (mvcc.curAt γ DFrac.discard o)

def mvcc.csContract (P : IProp GF) (f : val) (Pre Q Post : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(Pre ∗ (□ □ ∀ Φ, P ∗ Pre -∗ ▷ (Q -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP (f (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) ∗ (Q ={⊤}=∗ P ∗ Post))

def mvcc.revMuCur (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ p o, mvcc.curAt (γ.withPhys p) (DFrac.own q.half.half.half) o ∗ mvcc.revMuBodyL s γ (γ.withPhys p) q)

def mvcc.commitLog (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) : mvcc.Log :=
  if pend = [] then ilog else ilog ++ [pend]

def mvcc.hookP (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  savedPropOwn γ.hook DFrac.discard P

def mvcc.muInv (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ c, mvcc.muInvAt s γ q c ∗ ghostVar γ.wr q () ∗ mvcc.fieldShare s γ q.half)

theorem mvcc.fieldShare_gather (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) :
    mvcc.fieldShare s γ (Qp.half 1) ∗ mvcc.fieldShare s γ (Qp.half 1).half ∗ mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ
    (Qp.half 1).half o ⊢ mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ 1 o

def mvcc.batchTxInitSpec (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (RT WT W Wi Dep : IProp GF) (LockedO : Nat → IProp GF)
    (P : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((□
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            RT ∗ WT -∗
              ▷ (LockedO 0 ∗ Wi ∗ P ∗ RT -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                WP
                  ((intoVal
                      (methods bt.ty
                        go!"LockOutsideApply"
                        bt.v))
                    (intoVal ()))
                  {{ Φ }}) ∗
      (□
          ∀ n b,
            □
              ∀ Φ,
                LockedO n ∗
                    ⌜n < 2⌝ ∗
                      (typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Key) b DFrac.discard ∨
                        typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Meta) b DFrac.discard) -∗
                  ▷ (LockedO (n + 1) -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                    WP
                      ((intoVal
                          (methods bt.ty
                            go!"UnsafeCreateBucket"
                            bt.v))
                        (intoVal b))
                      {{ Φ }}) ∗
        □
          ∀ n,
            □
              ∀ Φ,
                LockedO n ∗ W ∗ P -∗
                  ▷ (□ Dep -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                    WP ((intoVal (methods bt.ty go!"Unlock" bt.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

def mvcc.leaseName : GoString :=
  go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.leaseName

theorem mvcc.delKey_withPhys (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : mvcc.delKey (γ.withPhys p)
    = mvcc.delKey γ

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_idx_crev (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys
    p).idx.crev = γ.idx.crev

theorem mvcc.storeReq_of_wand (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (X Y : IProp GF) : □ (X -∗ Y) ⊢ mvcc.storeReq γ
    X Y

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_cperm (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys
    p).cperm = γ.cperm

def mvcc.finRev : Option w64 → Int :=
  match x✝ with
  | some x => sint.Z x
  | none => -1

theorem mvcc.nJobRd_le (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : mvcc.nJobRd kb ≤ 1

def mvcc.storeWT (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  mvcc.kbWT γ.kb

def mvcc.compactQueue (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ Ps p Q R, schedule.schedQueue γ.sch (Ps ++ [p]) ∗ schedule.savedProp p Q ∗ R ∗ (Q ∗ R -∗ mvcc.compactTok γ c))

theorem mvcc.bucketLog_withPhys (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) (L : mvcc.Log) (m :
    mvcc.Bucket) (h : mvcc.kbCmpM p.kb ↔ mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb) : mvcc.bucketLog γ L m ⊢ mvcc.bucketLog
    (γ.withPhys p) L m

def mvcc.crevFrozenN : Namespace :=
  (nroot.@"mvcc").@"crevFrozen"

def mvcc.txnEndPre (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : mvcc.TxnKind → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => iprop(True)
  | mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts deletes putSize =>
    iprop(∃ P f, mvcc.hookIs γ P f ∗ P ∗ mvcc.certOkNext γ ilog pend ∗ mvcc.logQPre γ ilog pend)

theorem mvcc.kbViewC_kbView (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) (γb : GName) (q : Qp) (m : mvcc.Bucket) :
    mvcc.kbViewC kb γb q m ⊢ mvcc.kbView kb γb q m

def mvcc.physOk (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ Ph Dep,
      "#Hhook" ∷ mvcc.hookP γ Ph ∗
        "#Hbk" ∷
            mvcc.isKeyBackendG o.b (mvcc.bucketView γ) (mvcc.storeRT γ) (mvcc.storeWT γ) iprop(False) (mvcc.storePutOk γ)
              (mvcc.delKey γ) (mvcc.storeW s γ) (mvcc.kbWi γ.kb) Dep (mvcc.storeCmp γ) Ph (mvcc.hookFn γ)
              (mvcc.storeReq γ) (mvcc.storeRb γ) (mvcc.storeBt γ) (mvcc.kbSR γ.kb) (mvcc.kbSRh γ.kb)
              (mvcc.kbMW γ.kb γ.bucket) (mvcc.kbHookNil γ.kb) ∗
          "#Hdep" ∷ □ Dep ∗
            "#Hti" ∷ mvcc.isTreeIndex o.ti γ.idx ∗
              "#HisSched" ∷ schedule.isFifo o.ssched γ.sch ∗
                "#HmwP" ∷ mvcc.physCmp s γ ∗
                  "#Hpay" ∷ mvcc.stopPayAt γ.sx γ.sch o ∗ "%Hcmt" ∷ ⌜mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb ↔ γ.cm = true⌝)

def mvcc.kbHookNil (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : IProp GF :=
  match kb with
  | none => iprop(False)
  | some d => backend.plHook d.γB func.nil

def mvcc.keyName : GoString :=
  go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.keyName

def mvcc.writerL (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ilog ntok,
      "Htoks" ∷ ownTokAuthDfrac γ.revs (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ntok ∗
        "%Hbudget" ∷ ⌜List.length ilog + ntok + 3 ≤ 2 ^ 63⌝ ∗
          "Hw" ∷ mvcc.idxWriter γ.idx ilog [] ∗
            "Hclog" ∷ ghostVar γ.clog (Qp.half 1) ilog ∗
              "Hwv" ∷ ghostVar γ.wv (Qp.half 1) ilog ∗
                "Hcur" ∷
                    typedPointsto
                      (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
                        go!"currentRev" s)
                      (W64 (↑(List.length ilog) - 1)) (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ∗
                  "#Hcert" ∷ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx ilog ∗ "%Hne" ∷ ⌜ilog ≠ []⌝ ∗ "Hlrd" ∷ lease.lessorRdOf γ.leases)

theorem mvcc.kbWTSupplyM_on (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) (h : mvcc.kbCmpM kb) : mvcc.kbWTSupplyM kb ⊣⊢
    mvcc.kbWTSupply kb

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_tko (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys p).tko
    = γ.tko

def mvcc.rangeOutcomeC (r : Loc) (err : GoInterface) (log : mvcc.Log) (rev : w64) (c : Int) (endNil
    : Bool) (k e : GoString) (ro : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.RangeOptions) : IProp GF
    :=
  iprop(⌜sint.Z ro.Rev' ≤ sint.Z rev ∧ sint.Z (mvcc.rangeRev rev ro.Rev') < c⌝ ∗
        (∃ ec,
            typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.ErrCompacted) (GoInterface.ok ec)
                DFrac.discard ∗
              ⌜err = GoInterface.ok ec⌝) ∗
          typedPointsto r { KVs' := slice.nil, Rev' := W64 0, Count' := W64 (-1) } (DFrac.own 1) ∨
      ⌜sint.Z ro.Rev' ≤ sint.Z rev → c ≤ sint.Z (mvcc.rangeRev rev ro.Rev')⌝ ∗
        mvcc.rangeOutcome r err log rev endNil k e ro)

theorem mvcc.snapThin_persistent (m m' : mvcc.Bucket) (Del : GoString → IProp GF) : Persistent
    (mvcc.snapThin m m' Del)

theorem mvcc.revLag_split (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q1 q2 : Qp) (c cp : Int) : mvcc.revLag γ (q1 + q2)
    c cp ⊣⊢ mvcc.revLag γ q1 c cp ∗ mvcc.revLag γ q2 c cp

theorem mvcc.unlockAt_persistent (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (W P U :
    IProp GF) (l : mvcc.Puts) : Persistent (mvcc.unlockAt bt View W P U l)

theorem mvcc.storeReader_toC (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : mvcc.storeReader s γ ⊢
    mvcc.storeReaderC s γ

def mvcc.bkNoCmp (γB : backend.BNames) : IProp GF :=
  backend.fkOwn γB 0

theorem mvcc.delKey_timeless (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (k : GoString) : Timeless (mvcc.delKey γ k)

theorem mvcc.crevFrozen_persistent (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : Persistent (mvcc.crevFrozen γ)

def mvcc.writerInvBody (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((∃ p o,
        mvcc.curAt (γ.withPhys p) (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1).half.half) o ∗
          (mvcc.writerL s (γ.withPhys p) ∗ mvcc.writerReg s (γ.withPhys p) ∨
            mvcc.writerKey (γ.withPhys p) ∗ mvcc.wDep γ ∗ mvcc.storeRegd s (γ.withPhys p))) ∨
      ghostVar γ.wr 1 () ∗ ∃ h, monoListAuthOwn γ.idx.hist (Qp.half 1) h)

theorem mvcc.isTxnWrite_join {trace : Loc} (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (chs : GoSlice) (ps : List Loc) (crev :
    Int) (Z : IProp GF := iprop(True)) (ld : Bool := false) : mvcc.isTxnWriteCore mw s γ trace ilog
    pend puts deletes putSize chs ps false crev Z ld ∗ ownSlice chs ps (DFrac.own 1) ∗
    mvcc.changesAre ps ilog pend ⊢ mvcc.isTxnWrite mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev
    Z ld

theorem mvcc.writerInv_persistent (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : Persistent (mvcc.writerInv s γ)

def mvcc.kvPtrIs (full : Bool) (p : Loc) (kv : EtcdKv) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ks st uf sc,
      ownSlice ks kv.key DFrac.discard ∗
        if full = true then
          ∃ vs,
            ownSlice vs kv.value DFrac.discard ∗
              typedPointsto p
                { state' := st, Key' := ks, CreateRevision' := kv.createRev, ModRevision' := kv.modRev,
                  Version' := kv.version, Value' := vs, Lease' := kv.lease, unknownFields' := uf, sizeCache' := sc }
                (DFrac.own 1)
        else
          typedPointsto p
            { state' := st, Key' := ks, CreateRevision' := kv.createRev, ModRevision' := kv.modRev,
              Version' := kv.version, Value' := slice.nil, Lease' := W64 0, unknownFields' := uf, sizeCache' := sc }
            (DFrac.own 1))

def mvcc.bNames_countable : Pos.Countable backend.BNames :=
  countableOfLeftInverse
    (fun x =>
      (x.rbD, x.fkv, x.fk, x.dlb, x.dlg, x.cln, x.rbk, x.hkd, x.db, x.view, x.rd, x.hist, x.cached, x.cur, x.hook, x.opn,
        x.wb, x.rdt, x.txa, x.txb, x.rvs, x.cvw, x.wbc, x.used, x.cls, x.sdn, x.stk))
    (fun pr =>
      have r0' := pr.snd;
      have r := r0'.snd;
      have r' := r.snd;
      have r0 := r'.snd;
      have q0 := r0.snd;
      have q := q0.snd;
      have p := q.snd;
      { db := p.snd.fst, view := p.snd.snd.fst, rd := p.snd.snd.snd.fst, hist := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        cached := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, cur := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        hook := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, opn := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        wb := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, rdt := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        txa := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        txb := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        rvs := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        cvw := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        wbc := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        used := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        cls := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        sdn := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        stk := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd, hkd := p.fst, rbk := q.fst,
        cln := q0.fst, dlg := r0.fst, dlb := r'.fst, fk := r.fst, fkv := r0'.fst, rbD := pr.fst })
    mvcc.bNames_countable._proof_1

theorem mvcc.readerPool_checkin (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (dq : DFrac) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : ⊢ £ 1 -∗
    mvcc.readerPool γ -∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq o -∗ mvcc.idxSlot γ o -∗ ownToks γ.tko 1 ={⊤}=∗ ownToks
    γ.tk 1 ∗ mvcc.wDep γ ∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq o

  | some d => mvcc.bkViewC d.γB q m

def mvcc.kbWTSupply (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : IProp GF :=

  | none => iprop(True)
  | some d => iprop(□ (⧗1 ={⊤}=∗ backend.wbTok d.γB))

theorem mvcc.typedPointsto_parts {V : Type} [TypedPointsto V] (l : Loc) (v : V) (q1 q2 : Qp) (h : q1
    + q2 = 1) : typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own 1) ⊣⊢ typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own q1) ∗ typedPointsto
    l v (DFrac.own q2)

  countableOfLeftInverse (fun x => (x.b, x.ti, x.ssched, x.sstop))
    (fun p => { b := p.fst, ti := p.snd.fst, ssched := p.snd.snd.fst, sstop := p.snd.snd.snd }) ⋯

theorem mvcc.physCmp_off (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (h : ¬mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb) : ⊢ mvcc.physCmp s
    γ

def mvcc.rangeRev (rev optRev : w64) : w64 :=
  if sint.Z optRev ≤ 0 then rev else optRev

theorem mvcc.kbNoDel_persistent (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : Persistent (mvcc.kbNoDel kb)

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_cmeta (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys
    p).cmeta = p.cmeta

theorem mvcc.revQ_commit_post (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (h :
    pend ≠ []) : mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.idx (Qp.half 1) (ilog ++ [pend]) ⊢ mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.idx
    (mvcc.revQ γ 1) (ilog ++ [pend]) ∗ mvcc.logQPost γ ilog pend

theorem mvcc.logQPost_ne (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (h : pend
    ≠ []) (hw : γ.watchQ = true) : mvcc.logQPost γ ilog pend = mvcc.logQ γ (ilog ++ [pend])

theorem mvcc.isBatchTxG_noNil (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT WT :
    IProp GF) (PutOk : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop) (Del : GoString → IProp
    GF) (W Wi Dep : IProp GF) (Cmp : Prop) (P : IProp GF) (HF : val → IProp GF) (Rb : GMap GoString
    backend.BktData → IProp GF) (Bt : GoInterfaceOk → IProp GF) (MW HN : IProp GF) : mvcc.isBatchTxG
    bt View RT WT PutOk Del W Wi Dep Cmp P HF Rb Bt MW HN ⊢ mvcc.isBatchTxG bt View RT WT PutOk Del
    W Wi Dep Cmp P HF Rb Bt MW

def mvcc.keyView (vd : backend.VData) (m : mvcc.Bucket) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n k : GoString), vd !! (n, k) = if n = mvcc.keyName then m !! k else none

theorem mvcc.crevSafe_persistent (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : Persistent (mvcc.crevSafe γ c)

theorem mvcc.keyReadSnapC_persistent (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT NC : IProp GF) (rt :
    GoInterfaceOk) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (L : IProp GF) : Persistent (mvcc.keyReadSnapC View RT NC rt m
    L)

theorem mvcc.revToken_withPhys (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : mvcc.revToken
    (γ.withPhys p) = mvcc.revToken γ

def mvcc.kbWTSupplyM (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : IProp GF :=
  if mvcc.kbCmpM kb then mvcc.kbWTSupply kb else iprop(True)

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_clog (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys
    p).clog = γ.clog

theorem mvcc.isTxnRead_frozen (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (log : mvcc.Log) (rev
    : w64) (crev : Int) : ⊢ mvcc.isTxnRead mw s γ trace log rev crev (mvcc.crevFrozen γ) ={⊤}=∗
    mvcc.isTxnRead mw s γ trace log rev crev (mvcc.crevFrozen γ) ∗ ⌜crev = -1⌝

theorem mvcc.crevUB_get_lb (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (q : Qp) (c : Int) : mvcc.crevUB γ q c ⊢ mvcc.crevUB
    γ q c ∗ mvcc.crevLb γ c

theorem mvcc.keyReadLocked_persistent (RT NC : IProp GF) (rng : Bool) (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m :
    mvcc.Bucket) (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (Tok : IProp GF) (cl : Bool) : Persistent
    (mvcc.keyReadLocked RT NC rng rt m Rd Tok cl)

def mvcc.readerPool (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  inv mvcc.poolN
    iprop(∃ p o, mvcc.curAt (γ.withPhys p) (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1).half.half) o ∗ mvcc.poolBody (γ.withPhys p) o)

theorem mvcc.kbWTSupply_take (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : ⊢ mvcc.kbWTSupply kb ∗ ⧗1 ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.kbWT
    kb

def mvcc.kbPutOk (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop :=
  match (motive := Option mvcc.KBReal → mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop) kb with
  | none => mvcc.noPutCond
  | some val => mvcc.keyPutOk

structure mvcc.PhysNames : Type where
  nev : GName
  cmp : GName
  bucket : GName
  hook : GName
  hookFn : GName
  kb : Option mvcc.KBReal
  cmeta : GName
  fin : GName
  sch : schedule.SchedNames
  wk : GName
  wv : GName
  mwk : GName
  sx : GName

theorem mvcc.hookOk_agree_lc (E : CoPset) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P P' : IProp GF) (f f' : val) : £ 1
    ∗ mvcc.hookOk γ P f ∗ mvcc.hookOk γ P' f' ⊢ |={E}=> ⌜f = f'⌝ ∗ □ (P -∗ P') ∗ □ (P' -∗ P)

theorem mvcc.wDep_halves (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : ghostVar γ.wr sync.rfrac () ⊣⊢ mvcc.wDep γ ∗
    mvcc.wDep γ

theorem mvcc.hookP_agree_lc (E : CoPset) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P P' : IProp GF) (f : val) : £ 1 ∗
    mvcc.hookOk γ P f ∗ mvcc.hookP γ P' ⊢ |={E}=> □ (P -∗ P') ∗ □ (P' -∗ P)

theorem mvcc.readerPool_checkout (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (dq : DFrac) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : ⊢ £ 1 -∗
    mvcc.readerPool γ -∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq o -∗ ownToks γ.tk 1 -∗ mvcc.wDep γ ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.idxSlot γ o
    ∗ ownToks γ.tko 1 ∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq o

def mvcc.bkHookIs (γB : backend.BNames) (f : val) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ g, ⌜f = intoVal g ∧ g ≠ func.nil⌝ ∗ backend.plHookRO γB g)

theorem mvcc.hookIs_split (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) (f : val) : mvcc.hookIs γ P f ⊣⊢
    mvcc.hookOk γ P f ∗ mvcc.writerFrag γ

def mvcc.leaseBI : backend.BucketInfo :=
  { id := W64 3, name := mvcc.leaseName, safe := false }

theorem mvcc.ownTokAuthDfrac_split (γr : GName) (dq dq' : DFrac) (n : Nat) : ownTokAuthDfrac γr (dq
    • dq') n ⊣⊢ ownTokAuthDfrac γr dq n ∗ ownTokAuthDfrac γr dq' n

theorem mvcc.rdCap2_persistent (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (Tok : IProp GF) : Persistent
    (mvcc.rdCap2 Rd Tok)

def mvcc.keyReadLocked (RT NC : IProp GF) (rng : Bool) (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (Rd :
    GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (Tok : IProp GF) (cl : Bool := false) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((□
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            Tok -∗
              ▷ (RT -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                WP ((intoVal (methods rt.ty go!"RUnlock" rt.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) ∗
      □ mvcc.keyRangeSpec rt m Rd Tok ∗
        (if rng = true then
            □ mvcc.keyRangeReadSpec rt m Rd Tok ∗
              □ mvcc.keyRangeLimSpec rt m Rd Tok cl ∗
                □ mvcc.rdSplit rt m Rd Tok cl ∗ □ (NC -∗ NC ∗ □ mvcc.metaReadSpec rt true Rd Tok)
          else True) ∗
          mvcc.rdCap Rd Tok)

theorem mvcc.bucketLog_thin (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L : mvcc.Log) (m : mvcc.Bucket) : mvcc.bucketLog
    γ L m ⊢ mvcc.snapThin (mvcc.bucketMap L) m (mvcc.delKey γ)

theorem mvcc.crevPermAt_persistent (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : Persistent (mvcc.crevPermAt γ
    c)

def mvcc.isBatchTxG (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT WT : IProp GF)
    (PutOk : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop) (Del : GoString → IProp GF) (W Wi
    Dep : IProp GF) (Cmp : Prop) (P : IProp GF) (HF : val → IProp GF) (Rb : GMap GoString
    backend.BktData → IProp GF := fun x => iprop(True)) (Bt : GoInterfaceOk → IProp GF := fun x =>
    iprop(True)) (MW : IProp GF) (HN : IProp GF := iprop(False)) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ Locked LockedO,
      mvcc.batchTxSpecG bt View RT WT PutOk Del W Dep Cmp Locked P HF Rb MW HN ∗
        mvcc.batchTxInitSpec bt RT WT W Wi Dep LockedO P ∗ □ Bt bt)

theorem mvcc.isTxnWrite_trace_acc (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF :=
    iprop(True)) : mvcc.isTxnWrite mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev Z ⊢ (∃ te,
    traceutil.ownTrace trace te) ∗ ((∃ te, traceutil.ownTrace trace te) -∗ mvcc.isTxnWrite mw s γ
    trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev Z)

def mvcc.isWriteView (wv s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop("#Hkv" ∷
        typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.writeView go!"kv" wv)
          (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store.ty.PointerType (intoVal s)) DFrac.discard ∗
      "#Hs" ∷ mvcc.isStore s γ)

theorem mvcc.stopPay_persistent (γx : GName) : Persistent (mvcc.stopPay γx)

theorem mvcc.storeReader_retire (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (dq : DFrac) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) (n
    : Nat) : ⊢ £ 1 -∗ mvcc.isStore s γ -∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq o -∗ mvcc.storeReader s γ -∗
    mvcc.retiredAt γ n ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.storeRT γ ∗ mvcc.retiredAt γ (n + 1) ∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq o

def mvcc.isTxnWrite (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List
    mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF := iprop(True)) (ld : Bool
    := false) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ tw ranges,
      "Hmw" ∷
          typedPointsto mw
            {
              TxnWrite' :=
                interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.storeTxnWrite.ty.PointerType (intoVal tw),
              ranges' := ranges, puts' := puts, deletes' := deletes, putSize' := putSize }
            (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        "Htw" ∷ mvcc.storeTxnWriteIs tw s γ trace ilog pend crev Z ld ∗ "Htrc" ∷ ∃ te, traceutil.ownTrace trace te)

theorem mvcc.crevRight_split (γs : mvcc.StoreNames) : mvcc.crevUB γs.idx (Qp.half 1) (-1) ⊢ |={⊤}=>
    mvcc.wsFrozenM γs ∗ mvcc.crevRightM γs

def mvcc.restoreLogOk (R : mvcc.Log) : Prop :=
  (∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ R → cs ≠ []) ∧
    mvcc.IdxWf ([[], []] ++ R) [] ∧
      ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change),
        cs ∈ R → ∀ (c : mvcc.Change), c ∈ cs → ∀ (k v : GoString) (l : w64), c = mvcc.Change.put k v l → l = W64 0

def mvcc.storeNames_countable : Pos.Countable mvcc.StoreNames :=
  countableOfLeftInverse
    (fun x =>
      (((((x.idx, x.bucket, x.clog, x.leases, x.revs, x.hook, x.hookFn, x.kb, x.cmeta, x.fin, x.sch, x.cok, x.watchQ,
                x.wr, x.wk, x.wv, x.cur, x.rst, x.tk, x.tko, x.wsd, x.tkw),
              x.tkr),
            x.mwk),
          x.cm, x.sx),
        x.cperm))
    (fun r1 =>
      have r0 := r1.fst;
      have r := r0.fst;
      have q := r.fst;
      have p := q.fst;
      { idx := p.fst, bucket := p.snd.fst, clog := p.snd.snd.fst, leases := p.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        revs := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, hook := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, hookFn := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        kb := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, cmeta := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        fin := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, sch := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        cok := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        watchQ := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        wr := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        wk := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        wv := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        cur := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        rst := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        tk := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        tko := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        wsd := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        tkw := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd, tkr := q.snd,
        mwk := r.snd, cm := r0.snd.fst, sx := r0.snd.snd, cperm := r1.snd })
    mvcc.storeNames_countable._proof_1

theorem mvcc.crevUB_lb_keep (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (q : Qp) (c c' : Int) (hc : -1 ≤ c) : mvcc.crevUB γ
    q c ∗ mvcc.crevLb γ c' ⊢ mvcc.crevUB γ q c ∗ ⌜c' ≤ c⌝

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_rst (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys p).rst
    = γ.rst

def mvcc.restoreViewOut (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (R : mvcc.Log) : IProp GF :=
  if R = [] then mvcc.bucketView γ q ∅ else mvcc.bucketViewC γ q (mvcc.bucketMap ([[], []] ++ R))

theorem mvcc.noCompactor_frozen (γs : mvcc.StoreNames) : mvcc.noCompactor γs ⊢ mvcc.crevFrozen γs

def mvcc.physCmp (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  if mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb then iprop(mvcc.mwInv γ ∗ mvcc.writerReg s γ) else iprop(True)

theorem mvcc.pairVals_persistent (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (ks vs : GoSlice) (l : List
    (GoString × GoString)) : Persistent (mvcc.pairVals Rd ks vs l)

def mvcc.kbNoCmp (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) (γb : GName) : IProp GF :=
  match kb with
  | none => mvcc.viewNoCmp γb
  | some d => mvcc.bkNoCmp d.γB

theorem mvcc.mwSwap_frame (K W MW : IProp GF) : □ (W -∗ K ∗ (K -∗ W)) ∗ mvcc.mwSwap K MW ⊢
    mvcc.mwSwap W MW

def mvcc.storePutOk (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop :=
  mvcc.kbPutOk γ.kb

theorem mvcc.crevPermIs_cperm (γ γ' : mvcc.StoreNames) (h : γ'.cperm = γ.cperm) (Perm : Int → IProp
    GF) : mvcc.crevPermIs γ Perm ⊢ mvcc.crevPermIs γ' Perm

def mvcc.storeW (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  match γ.kb with
  | none => mvcc.writerRes s γ
  | some d => mvcc.lateW d.gx

theorem mvcc.muHeld_cmp_idx (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) (ti : Loc) : mvcc.muHeld s γ c
    ti ⊢ typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
    go!"compactMainRev" s) (W64 c) (DFrac.own sync.rfrac.half) ∗ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx
    sync.rfrac.half.half c ∗ ⌜-1 ≤ c ∧ c < 2 ^ 63⌝ ∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"kvindex" s) (interface.mkOk
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.treeIndex.ty.PointerType (intoVal ti)) (DFrac.own
    sync.rfrac.half) ∗ (typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
    go!"compactMainRev" s) (W64 c) (DFrac.own sync.rfrac.half) -∗ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx
    sync.rfrac.half.half c -∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"kvindex" s) (interface.mkOk
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.treeIndex.ty.PointerType (intoVal ti)) (DFrac.own
    sync.rfrac.half) -∗ mvcc.muHeld s γ c ti)

theorem mvcc.isStore_withPhys (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : mvcc.isStore s
    (γ.withPhys p) = mvcc.isStore s γ

theorem mvcc.mkOk_loc_inj [GoLocalContext] [GoGlobalContext] [go.Semantics] (T : go.GoType) {a b :
    Loc} (h : interface.mkOk T (intoVal a) = interface.mkOk T (intoVal b)) : a = b

theorem mvcc.mwInv_persistent (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : Persistent (mvcc.mwInv γ)

def mvcc.unlockAt (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (W P U : IProp GF) (l :
    mvcc.Puts) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((□
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            U ∗ ⌜l = []⌝ ∗ W ∗ P -∗
              ▷ (True -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                WP ((intoVal (methods bt.ty go!"Unlock" bt.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) ∗
      □
        ∀ m Q,
          □
            ∀ Φ,
              U ∗ View 1 m ∗ (View 1 (List.foldl (fun m p => <[p.fst := p.snd]>m) m l) -∗ W ∗ Q) ∗ P -∗
                ▷ (Q -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                  WP ((intoVal (methods bt.ty go!"Unlock" bt.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

theorem mvcc.batchTxSpecG_noNil (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT WT :
    IProp GF) (PutOk : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop) (Del : GoString → IProp
    GF) (W Dep : IProp GF) (Cmp : Prop) (Locked : mvcc.Puts → IProp GF) (P : IProp GF) (HF : val →
    IProp GF) (Rb : GMap GoString backend.BktData → IProp GF) (MW HN : IProp GF) : mvcc.batchTxSpecG
    bt View RT WT PutOk Del W Dep Cmp Locked P HF Rb MW HN ⊢ mvcc.batchTxSpecG bt View RT WT PutOk
    Del W Dep Cmp Locked P HF Rb MW

theorem mvcc.storeW_put (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : mvcc.storeRegd s γ ∗ mvcc.writerRes s γ ⊢
    mvcc.storeW s γ

theorem mvcc.idxKnows_wf (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (kn : mvcc.IdxKnow) : mvcc.idxKnows γ kn ⊢
    mvcc.idxKnows γ kn ∗ ⌜mvcc.LogWf' kn.log ∧ List.length kn.log < 2 ^ 63 ∧ ∀ (cs : List
    mvcc.Change), cs ∈ kn.log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63⌝

  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.storeTxnRead
    go!"storeTxnCommon" tr

    mvcc.revMuTok γ γp q ⊢ mvcc.revMuInv s γ q

theorem mvcc.bkBt_persistent (be : Loc) (bt : GoInterfaceOk) : Persistent (mvcc.bkBt be bt)

theorem mvcc.crevLb_withPhys (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) (c : Int) : mvcc.crevLb
    (γ.withPhys p).idx c = mvcc.crevLb γ.idx c

theorem mvcc.revQ_commit_pre (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (h :
    pend ≠ []) : mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.idx (mvcc.revQ γ 1) ilog ∗ mvcc.logQPre γ ilog pend ⊢
    mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.idx (Qp.half 1) ilog

def mvcc.keyRangeReadSpec (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp
    GF) (Tok : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ b lo hi klo khi dqlo dqhi,
      □
        ∀ Φ,
          typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Key) b DFrac.discard ∗
              Tok ∗ ownSlice lo klo dqlo ∗ ownSlice hi khi dqhi ∗ ⌜khi ≠ []⌝ -∗
            (▷
                ∀ ks vs,
                  Tok ∗ ownSlice lo klo dqlo ∗ ownSlice hi khi dqhi ∗ mvcc.rangeVals Rd ks vs m klo khi -∗
                    Φ (intoVal ks, intoVal vs)) -∗
              WP
                (((((intoVal
                          (methods rt.ty go!"UnsafeRange" rt.v))
                        (intoVal b))
                      (intoVal lo))
                    (intoVal hi))
                  (intoVal (W64 0)))
                {{ Φ }})

def mvcc.isKeyBackendG (b : GoInterface) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT WT NC : IProp GF)
    (PutOk : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop) (Del : GoString → IProp GF) (W Wi
    Dep : IProp GF) (Cmp : Prop) (P : IProp GF) (HF : val → IProp GF) (Req : IProp GF → IProp GF →
    IProp GF := fun X Y => iprop(□ (X -∗ Y))) (Rb : GMap GoString backend.BktData → IProp GF := fun
    x => iprop(True)) (Bt : GoInterfaceOk → IProp GF := fun x => iprop(True)) (SR SRh : IProp GF :=
    iprop(True)) (MW : IProp GF) (HN : IProp GF := iprop(False)) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ bi,
      ⌜b = GoInterface.ok bi⌝ ∗
        (□
            ∀ q m,
              □
                ∀ Φ,
                  View q m ∗ RT -∗
                    (▷
                        ∀ rt,
                          (View q m ∗ ∃ L, L ∗ mvcc.keyReadSnap View RT NC Del false rt m L) -∗
                            Φ (intoVal (GoInterface.ok rt))) -∗
                      WP
                        ((intoVal
                            (methods bi.ty
                              go!"ConcurrentReadTx"
                              bi.v))
                          (intoVal ()))
                        {{ Φ }}) ∗
          (□
              ∀ q m,
                □
                  ∀ Φ,
                    View q m ∗ RT -∗
                      (▷
                          ∀ rt,
                            (View q m ∗ ∃ L, L ∗ mvcc.keyReadSnap View RT NC Del true rt m L) -∗
                              Φ (intoVal (GoInterface.ok rt))) -∗
                        WP ((intoVal (methods bi.ty go!"ReadTx" bi.v)) (intoVal ()))
                          {{ Φ }}) ∗
            (□
                □
                  ∀ Φ,
                    True -∗
                      (▷
                          ∀ bt,
                            mvcc.isBatchTxG bt View RT WT PutOk Del W Wi Dep Cmp P HF Rb Bt MW HN -∗
                              Φ (intoVal (GoInterface.ok bt))) -∗
                        WP ((intoVal (methods bi.ty go!"BatchTx" bi.v)) (intoVal ()))
                          {{ Φ }}) ∗
              (□
                  ∀ X Y,
                    □
                      ∀ Φ,
                        RT ∗ WT ∗ X ∗ Req X Y -∗
                          ▷ (RT ∗ Y -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                            WP
                              ((intoVal
                                  (methods bi.ty
                                    go!"ForceCommit" bi.v))
                                (intoVal ()))
                              {{ Φ }}) ∗
                (□
                    □
                      ∀ Φ,
                        True -∗
                          (▷ ∀ n, True -∗ Φ (intoVal n)) -∗
                            WP ((intoVal (methods bi.ty go!"Size" bi.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) ∗
                  (□
                      □
                        ∀ Φ,
                          True -∗
                            (▷ ∀ n, True -∗ Φ (intoVal n)) -∗
                              WP
                                ((intoVal
                                    (methods bi.ty go!"SizeInUse" bi.v))
                                  (intoVal ()))
                                {{ Φ }}) ∗
                    □
                      (⌜Cmp⌝ -∗
                        (□
                            □
                              ∀ Φ,
                                SR -∗
                                  ▷ (SRh -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                                    WP
                                      ((intoVal
                                          (methods bi.ty
                                            go!"LockForSafeRangeDelete"
                                            bi.v))
                                        (intoVal ()))
                                      {{ Φ }}) ∗
                          (□
                              □
                                ∀ Φ,
                                  SRh -∗
                                    ▷ (SR -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                                      WP
                                        ((intoVal
                                            (methods bi.ty
                                              go!"UnlockForSafeRangeDelete"
                                              bi.v))
                                          (intoVal ()))
                                        {{ Φ }}) ∗
                            □
                              □
                                ∀ Φ,
                                  True -∗
                                    (▷ ∀ rt, mvcc.metaReadTx rt RT -∗ Φ (intoVal (GoInterface.ok rt))) -∗
                                      WP
                                        ((intoVal (methods bi.ty go!"ReadTx" bi.v))
                                          (intoVal ()))
                                        {{ Φ }}))

def mvcc.revQ (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) : Qp :=
  if γ.watchQ = true then q.half.half else q.half

def mvcc.kbCmp (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : Prop :=
  mvcc.kbCmpM kb

def mvcc.KBReal.P (d : mvcc.KBReal) : backend.BParams :=
  { BT := d.BT, HB := fun n => decide (n ≠ mvcc.keyName), SB := fun n => decide (n = mvcc.keyName),
    HK := fun n k =>
      decide
        (n = go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.metaName ∧
          (k = go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.ciKeyBytes ∨
            k = go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.termKeyBytes)),
    RB := fun n => decide (n ∈ mvcc.restBuckets), hookMax := d.hookMax, limit := d.limit, FV := mvcc.metaRevVal }

theorem mvcc.writerInv_checkin (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L : mvcc.Log) (dq : DFrac) (o :
    mvcc.StoreObjs) : ⊢ £ 1 -∗ mvcc.writerInv s γ -∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq o -∗ mvcc.writerL s γ -∗
    ghostVar γ.wv (Qp.half 1) L ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.writerKey γ ∗ mvcc.wDep γ ∗ ghostVar γ.wv (Qp.half 1) L
    ∗ mvcc.curAt γ dq o

theorem mvcc.bucketViewL_init (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) : mvcc.bucketView γ q ∅ ⊢
    mvcc.bucketViewL γ q [[], []]

theorem mvcc.StoreNames.withPhys_idx_log (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys
    p).idx.log = γ.idx.log

theorem mvcc.hookOk_of_init (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) (f : val) (d : mvcc.KBReal) (h :
    γ.kb = some d) (g : GoFunc) (hg : g ≠ func.nil) : mvcc.hookInit γ P f ∗ backend.plHookRO d.γB g
    ⊢ mvcc.hookOk γ P (intoVal g)

theorem mvcc.certOk_timeless (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (log : mvcc.Log) : Timeless (mvcc.certOk γ log)

theorem mvcc.crevPermAt_elim_timeless (E : CoPset) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (Perm : Int → IProp GF) (c
    : Int) [Timeless (Perm c)] : mvcc.crevPermIs γ Perm ∗ mvcc.crevPermAt γ c ⊢ |={E}=> ⌜c = -1⌝ ∨ □
    Perm c

theorem mvcc.certFree_certOk (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (log : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.certFree γ ⊢ mvcc.certOk
    γ log

theorem mvcc.isWriteView_persistent (wv s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : Persistent
    (mvcc.isWriteView wv s γ)

theorem mvcc.revMuBodyL_fractional (s : Loc) (γ γp : mvcc.StoreNames) : Fractional (mvcc.revMuBodyL
    s γ γp)

theorem mvcc.rep_sub (P : IProp GF) (m n : Nat) (h : m ≤ n) : ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate n (), P)
    ⊢ ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate (n - m) (), P) ∗ [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate m (), P

def mvcc.kbNoDel (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) : IProp GF :=
  match kb with
  | none => iprop(True)
  | some d => backend.dlNoDel d.γB

def mvcc.rangeKvs (full : Bool) (kvs : GoSlice) (st : List EtcdKv) (answers : List (GoString ×
    mvcc.Rev × w64 × w64)) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ps,
      ownSlice kvs ps (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        ⌜ps.length = answers.length⌝ ∗
          [∗list] pa ∈ ps.zip answers, iprop(∃ kv, ⌜mvcc.findKey pa.snd.fst st = some kv⌝ ∗ mvcc.kvPtrIs full pa.fst kv))

theorem mvcc.muInv_withPhys (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : mvcc.muInv s
    (γ.withPhys p) = mvcc.muInv s γ

theorem mvcc.hookP_persistent (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) : Persistent (mvcc.hookP γ P)

def mvcc.lateW (gx : GName) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(dghostVar gx (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) none ∨ ∃ s γ, dghostVar gx DFrac.discard (some (s, γ)) ∗ mvcc.writerRes s γ)

theorem mvcc.revMuInv_closeL (s : Loc) (γ γp : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) : mvcc.revMuBodyL s γ γp q
    ∗ mvcc.revMuTok γ γp q ⊢ mvcc.revMuInv s γ q

theorem mvcc.physCmp_alloc (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : ⊢ mvcc.mwRest γ ∗ (if mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb
    then mvcc.kbMW γ.kb γ.bucket else True) ∗ mvcc.writerReg s γ ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.physCmp s γ

def mvcc.bkReq (γB : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (X Y : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□ (X -∗ Y) ∨ ∃ W Pk, backend.isBackend γB P W Pk b ∗ backend.commitReq γB P Pk b X Y)

theorem mvcc.idxLogAuth_withPhys (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) (q : Qp) (L : mvcc.Log)
    : mvcc.idxLogAuth (γ.withPhys p).idx q L = mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.idx q L

def mvcc.keyRangeLimSpec (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF)
    (Tok : IProp GF) (cl : Bool := false) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ b lo hi klo khi dqlo dqhi lim,
      □
        ∀ Φ,
          typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Key) b DFrac.discard ∗
              Tok ∗ ownSlice lo klo dqlo ∗ ownSlice hi khi dqhi ∗ ⌜khi ≠ []⌝ -∗
            (▷
                ∀ ks vs,
                  (Tok ∗
                      ownSlice lo klo dqlo ∗
                        ownSlice hi khi dqhi ∗
                          ∃ res,
                            mvcc.pairVals Rd ks vs res ∗
                              ⌜res.Sublist (mvcc.bucketRange m klo khi) ∧
                                  (cl = true →
                                    0 < sint.Z lim → res = List.take (sint.Z lim).toNat (mvcc.bucketRange m klo khi))⌝) -∗
                    Φ (intoVal ks, intoVal vs)) -∗
              WP
                (((((intoVal
                          (methods rt.ty go!"UnsafeRange" rt.v))
                        (intoVal b))
                      (intoVal lo))
                    (intoVal hi))
                  (intoVal lim))
                {{ Φ }})

def mvcc.storeCmp (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : Prop :=
  mvcc.kbCmp γ.kb

theorem mvcc.isTxn_trace_acc (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (kind : mvcc.TxnKind)
    (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF := iprop(True)) : mvcc.isTxn mw s γ trace kind crev Z ⊢ (∃ te,
    traceutil.ownTrace trace te) ∗ ((∃ te, traceutil.ownTrace trace te) -∗ mvcc.isTxn mw s γ trace
    kind crev Z)

theorem mvcc.readerPool_withPhys (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : mvcc.readerPool
    (γ.withPhys p) = mvcc.readerPool γ

theorem mvcc.errorfIs_persistent (err : GoInterface) : Persistent (mvcc.errorfIs err)

def mvcc.writerPin (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (log : mvcc.Log) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.bucketViewL γ (Qp.half 1).half log ∗ mvcc.writerLoan γ)

def mvcc.kvOver (kv : GoInterface) (s : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜kv = interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store.ty.PointerType (intoVal s)⌝ ∨
      ∃ ws,
        ⌜kv = interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore.ty.PointerType (intoVal ws)⌝ ∗
          typedPointsto
            (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore go!"store" ws)
            s DFrac.discard)

def mvcc.mwInv (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  inv mvcc.mwN iprop(∃ b, ghostVar γ.mwk (Qp.half 1) b ∗ if b = true then mvcc.kbMW γ.kb γ.bucket else True)

theorem mvcc.keyReadLocked_split (RT NC : IProp GF) (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (Rd :
    GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (Tok : IProp GF) (cl : Bool := false) : mvcc.keyReadLocked RT NC
    true rt m Rd Tok cl ⊢ □ mvcc.rdSplit rt m Rd Tok cl

def mvcc.revMuBody (s : Loc) (γ γp : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ log ntok c,
      "Hrev" ∷
          typedPointsto
            (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
              go!"currentRev" s)
            (W64 (↑(List.length log) - 1)) (DFrac.own q.half) ∗
        "Hclog" ∷ ghostVar γ.clog q.half log ∗
          "#Hcert" ∷ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx log ∗
            "#Hnev" ∷ mvcc.idxNevLb γp.idx log ∗
              "#Hok" ∷ mvcc.certOk γ log ∗
                "%Hne" ∷ ⌜log ≠ []⌝ ∗
                  "Hbucket" ∷ mvcc.bucketViewL γp q.half log ∗
                    "Htoks" ∷ ownTokAuthDfrac γ.revs (DFrac.own q.half) ntok ∗
                      "%Hbudget" ∷ ⌜List.length log + ntok + 3 ≤ 2 ^ 63⌝ ∗
                        "Hlog" ∷ mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.idx (mvcc.revQ γ q) log ∗
                          "Hcmp" ∷
                              typedPointsto
                                (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
                                  go!"compactMainRev"
                                  s)
                                (W64 c) (DFrac.own q.half) ∗
                            "Hcrev" ∷ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx q.half.half c ∗
                              "#Hperm" ∷ mvcc.crevPermAt γ c ∗ "%Hc" ∷ ⌜-1 ≤ c ∧ c < ↑(List.length log)⌝)

theorem mvcc.lockNilSpec_persistent (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (RT WT W P HN : IProp GF) (Locked :
    mvcc.Puts → IProp GF) : Persistent (mvcc.lockNilSpec bt RT WT W P HN Locked)

def mvcc.poolN : Namespace :=
  (nroot.@"mvcc").@"readers"

theorem mvcc.idxSlots_of (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) (n : Nat) : (([∗list] _x ∈
    List.replicate n (), mvcc.idxReader o.ti γ.idx) ∗ [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate n (), mvcc.storeRT
    γ) ⊢ [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate n (), mvcc.idxSlot γ o
